creators.name: Heli Väätäjä
creators.role: Principal lecturer, Lapland University of Applied Sciences; formerly Tampere University of Technology
creators.bio: HCI researcher who has worked on dog activity tracking, dog–human bonding technology and research ethics for studies with animals.
creators.why: She wrote one of the first ethics guidelines for HCI studies that involve animals.
creators.role_zh: 拉普兰应用科学大学首席讲师，曾任职于坦佩雷理工大学
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究狗的活动追踪、狗与人之间的联结技术，以及涉及动物研究的伦理。
creators.why_zh: 她写出了最早一批针对涉及动物的人机交互研究的伦理指南之一。

creators.name: Hanna Wirman
creators.role: Game researcher; formerly The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, now IT University of Copenhagen
creators.bio: Game scholar who designed and studied touchscreen games for orangutans and asked how play can cross species lines.
creators.why: Her orangutan game work brought game studies into Animal–Computer Interaction.
creators.role_zh: 游戏研究者，曾任职于香港理工大学，现任职于哥本哈根信息技术大学
creators.bio_zh: 游戏学者，为红毛猩猩设计并研究触屏游戏，追问玩耍能否跨越物种界限。
creators.why_zh: 她关于红毛猩猩游戏的研究把游戏研究带进了动物-计算机交互领域。

creators.name: Hill Hiroki Kobayashi
creators.role: Associate Professor, Information Technology Center, The University of Tokyo
creators.bio: Researcher who builds remote sensing, live-sound and animal-worn systems for wildlife, from forest deer to the Fukushima exclusion zone.
creators.why: He extends ACI into wild environments, where animals carry the sensors and the network.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学信息技术中心副教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，为野生动物构建远程感知、实时声音和动物佩戴的系统，从森林里的鹿到福岛禁区都有涉及。
creators.why_zh: 他把动物-计算机交互延伸到野外：由动物携带传感器，甚至由动物组成网络。

creators.name: Clint Zeagler
creators.role: Research scientist in wearable technology, Georgia Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Wearable-computing designer who co-developed touchscreens, vests and interfaces that working dogs can operate.
creators.why: His work treats dogs as users of wearable and touchscreen interfaces, not only as tracked subjects.
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院可穿戴技术研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 可穿戴计算设计者，参与开发了工作犬可以自己操作的触摸屏、背心和界面。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究把狗当作可穿戴设备和触摸屏的使用者，而不只是被追踪的对象。

creators.name: Ceara Byrne
creators.role: Researcher in Animal–Computer Interaction; PhD, Georgia Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Researcher who built instrumented dog toys, home touchscreens for assistance dogs and a dog-driven robot.
creators.why: She showed how sensors in play objects can predict which dogs will succeed as service animals.
creators.role_zh: 动物-计算机交互研究者，佐治亚理工学院博士
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，制作了带传感器的狗玩具、供辅助犬在家中使用的触摸屏，以及由狗驾驶的机器人。
creators.why_zh: 她证明了玩具里的传感器可以预测哪些狗能成为合格的服务犬。

creators.name: Giancarlo Valentin
creators.role: Researcher, Georgia Institute of Technology (FIDO project)
creators.bio: Computing researcher who worked on gesture-based communication systems through which dogs can send messages to people.
creators.why: His head-gesture work asks what a dog-to-human vocabulary could look like.
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院研究者（FIDO 项目）
creators.bio_zh: 计算机研究者，研究让狗通过手势向人传递信息的交流系统。
creators.why_zh: 他关于头部手势的研究追问：从狗到人的词汇可以是什么样子。

creators.name: Joelle Alcaidinho
creators.role: Researcher, Georgia Institute of Technology (Animal–Computer Interaction)
creators.bio: Researcher who designed collar-sensed gestures for dogs and mobile tools for police explosive-detection teams.
creators.why: Her work links dog behaviour sensing with the collaboration needs of human handlers.
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院研究者（动物-计算机交互）
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，为狗设计了项圈感应的手势，并为警方爆炸物搜查队开发了移动协作工具。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究把对狗行为的感知与人类训导员的协作需求连接起来。

creators.name: Sean Mealin
creators.role: Computer scientist; PhD, North Carolina State University
creators.bio: Researcher who developed wearable sensing to help guide dog handlers and trainers read dogs' physiology and behaviour.
creators.why: His work makes canine body signals available to handlers without relying on sight.
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家，北卡罗来纳州立大学博士
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，开发可穿戴传感技术，帮助导盲犬的使用者和训练者读取狗的生理与行为。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究让训导员不依赖视觉也能获知狗的身体信号。

creators.name: Alper Bozkurt
creators.role: Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering, North Carolina State University
creators.bio: Engineer who builds wearable and implantable sensor systems for animals, including smart harnesses for guide dogs in training.
creators.why: His lab turned canine wearables into tools used by guide dog schools and volunteer puppy raisers.
creators.role_zh: 北卡罗来纳州立大学电气与计算机工程教授
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，为动物制作可穿戴和植入式传感系统，包括训练中导盲犬使用的智能背带。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室把狗的可穿戴设备变成了导盲犬学校和志愿寄养家庭实际使用的工具。

creators.name: David L. Roberts
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, North Carolina State University
creators.bio: Computer scientist who applies machine learning and sensing to dog behaviour, welfare and guide dog selection.
creators.why: He co-leads one of the largest long-running programmes on sensing for working dogs.
creators.role_zh: 北卡罗来纳州立大学计算机科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，把机器学习和传感技术用于狗的行为、福利和导盲犬选拔。
creators.why_zh: 他共同领导着规模最大、持续时间最长的工作犬传感研究项目之一。

creators.name: Ann Morrison
creators.role: Interaction design researcher; formerly Aalborg University, now University of Southern Queensland
creators.bio: Researcher who designed a vibrotactile vest for hunting dogs and a self-activated wave machine for a zoo platypus.
creators.why: Her projects give animals choice and control through touch and water movement.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计研究者，曾任职于奥尔堡大学，现任职于南昆士兰大学
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，为猎犬设计了振动触觉背心，也为动物园里的鸭嘴兽做了可自主触发的造浪装置。
creators.why_zh: 她的项目通过触觉和水流让动物获得选择权和控制权。

creators.name: Alexandre Pongrácz Rossi
creators.role: Animal behaviourist and dog trainer
creators.bio: Brazilian animal behaviour specialist known for training dogs to use communication devices and video calls.
creators.why: His Skype-trained dog showed that dogs can respond to their owner's cues over a video link.
creators.role_zh: 动物行为学者、训犬师
creators.bio_zh: 巴西动物行为专家，以训练狗使用交流设备和视频通话而闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他训练的狗证明了狗能通过视频连线回应主人的指令。

creators.name: Jun Rekimoto
creators.role: Professor, Interfaculty Initiative in Information Studies, The University of Tokyo; Sony Computer Science Laboratories
creators.bio: Pioneer of augmented reality and ubiquitous interfaces whose lab has also built sensing and display systems for cats and aquarium animals.
creators.why: His lab's Cat@Log and AquaPrism brought playful interface research to pets.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学情报学环教授；索尼计算机科学研究所
creators.bio_zh: 增强现实和普适界面的先驱，他的实验室也为猫和水族动物开发了感知与显示系统。
creators.why_zh: 他实验室的 Cat@Log 和 AquaPrism 把好玩的界面研究带到了宠物身上。

creators.name: Reinhard Gupfinger
creators.role: Artist and researcher, Tangible Music Lab, University of Art and Design Linz
creators.bio: Media artist who designs musical instruments and sonic interfaces for grey parrots living in captivity.
creators.why: He approaches ACI from sound art: instruments built around a parrot's body and hearing.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者，林茨艺术与设计大学 Tangible Music Lab
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家，为圈养的非洲灰鹦鹉设计乐器和声音界面。
creators.why_zh: 他从声音艺术进入动物-计算机交互：围绕鹦鹉的身体和听觉来造乐器。

creators.name: Stuart Gray
creators.role: Lecturer in Engineering Design, University of Bristol
creators.bio: Engineer and designer who led Gorilla Game Lab, building modular cognitive puzzles with Bristol Zoo's gorillas.
creators.why: His project showed how modular, tangible hardware can keep zoo enrichment new over time.
creators.role_zh: 布里斯托大学工程设计讲师
creators.bio_zh: 工程师和设计师，领导 Gorilla Game Lab，与布里斯托动物园的大猩猩一起制作模块化认知谜题。
creators.why_zh: 他的项目展示了模块化、可触摸的硬件如何让动物园丰容保持新鲜感。

creators.name: Christopher Flynn Martin
creators.role: Director of Research, Indianapolis Zoo
creators.bio: Primatologist who builds touchscreen systems for chimpanzees and orangutans, from the Arena shared touch-panel to the portable ApeTouch.
creators.why: He made primate touchscreen tasks available to zoos as enrichment, not only as lab tests.
creators.role_zh: 印第安纳波利斯动物园研究主任
creators.bio_zh: 灵长类学者，为黑猩猩和红毛猩猩开发触摸屏系统，从共享触控台 Arena 到便携式 ApeTouch。
creators.why_zh: 他让灵长类触屏任务从实验室测试变成动物园可用的丰容手段。

creators.name: Steve North
creators.role: Researcher in human–horse interaction, University of Exeter
creators.bio: Researcher who studies how horses and people communicate and builds equine prototypes such as robotic horse ears.
creators.why: He brings horses into ACI, a species rarely addressed by interaction design.
creators.role_zh: 埃克塞特大学人马互动研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究马与人如何交流，并制作机器马耳这类面向马的原型。
creators.why_zh: 他把马带进了动物-计算机交互，而交互设计很少关注这一物种。

creators.name: Stacey D. Scott
creators.role: Professor, School of Computer Science, University of Guelph
creators.bio: HCI researcher whose group studies collaborative interfaces and applies user-centred and animal-centred design to livestock farming.
creators.why: Her group connected ACI with precision livestock farming.
creators.role_zh: 圭尔夫大学计算机科学学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，她的团队研究协作界面，并把以用户为中心、以动物为中心的设计用到畜牧业中。
creators.why_zh: 她的团队把动物-计算机交互与精准畜牧业连接了起来。

creators.name: Luisa Ruge
creators.role: Designer and researcher; PhD, The Open University ACI Laboratory
creators.bio: Industrial designer who developed methods for evaluating animal usability and an ethics toolkit for animal-centred research.
creators.why: She turned animal-centred ethics into tools designers can use during a project.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、研究者，开放大学动物-计算机交互实验室博士
creators.bio_zh: 工业设计师，开发了评估动物可用性的方法，以及面向以动物为中心研究的伦理工具包。
creators.why_zh: 她把以动物为中心的伦理变成了设计师在项目中可以直接使用的工具。

creators.name: Yoav Golan
creators.role: Researcher, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev
creators.bio: Engineer who built a vibration vest and showed that a dog can learn to follow distinct haptic commands.
creators.why: His work makes touch a practical command channel for working dogs.
creators.role_zh: 内盖夫本-古里安大学机械工程系研究者
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，制作了振动背心，证明狗可以学会区分并执行不同的触觉指令。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究让触觉成为工作犬可用的指令通道。

creators.name: Jennifer Cunha
creators.role: Founder, Parrot Kindergarten; researcher at Northeastern University
creators.bio: Parrot trainer and researcher who taught a Goffin's cockatoo, Ellie, to use a tablet speech board and studies parrot video calls.
creators.why: Her long-term case studies are the main evidence for how parrots use augmentative communication devices.
creators.role_zh: Parrot Kindergarten 创始人，东北大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 鹦鹉训练师和研究者，教会一只名叫 Ellie 的戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉使用平板语音板，并研究鹦鹉之间的视频通话。
creators.why_zh: 她的长期个案研究是鹦鹉如何使用辅助沟通设备的主要证据。

creators.name: Shuyi Sun
creators.role: Researcher, Interactive Organisms Lab, University of California, Davis
creators.bio: Designer-researcher who builds biosensing litter boxes, toys and wearables for pet health monitoring.
creators.why: Her work makes a pet's urine, saliva and movement readable at home without a vet visit.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校 Interactive Organisms Lab 研究者
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，为宠物健康监测制作生物传感猫砂盆、玩具和可穿戴设备。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究让宠物的尿液、唾液和运动在家里就能被读取，不必去兽医那里。

creators.name: Charles Ramey
creators.role: Researcher in wearable and embedded sensing, Georgia Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Engineer who builds sensor systems for sled dogs, otters, elephants and dolphins with Thad Starner and Melody Jackson.
creators.why: He instruments enrichment objects so caretakers can see how animals use them over time.
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院可穿戴与嵌入式传感研究者
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，与 Thad Starner 和 Melody Jackson 合作，为雪橇犬、水獭、大象和海豚制作传感系统。
creators.why_zh: 他在丰容物件里装入传感器，让饲养员看到动物长期如何使用它们。

creators.name: Arianna Mastali
creators.role: PhD researcher, Georgia Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Researcher who designed an audio enrichment system for the elephants at Zoo Atlanta.
creators.why: Her elephant wall adds sound, controlled by the elephants' trunks, to food enrichment.
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，为亚特兰大动物园的大象设计了音频丰容系统。
creators.why_zh: 她在大象的觅食墙上加入了由象鼻触发的声音。

creators.name: Dirk van der Linden
creators.role: Associate Professor, Department of Computer and Information Sciences, Northumbria University
creators.bio: Researcher on privacy and values in technology who writes critically on pet wearables and on what 'animal-centred' should mean.
creators.why: He argues ACI must move from animal usability to animal dignity.
creators.role_zh: 诺森比亚大学计算机与信息科学系副教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究技术中的隐私与价值，批判性地讨论宠物可穿戴设备，以及“以动物为中心”应当意味着什么。
creators.why_zh: 他主张动物-计算机交互应当从关注动物的可用性转向关注动物的尊严。

creators.name: Aphrodite Theodora Andreou
creators.role: Researcher, Institute of Digital Games, University of Malta
creators.bio: Designer-researcher who co-designed enrichment toys with a group of bottlenose dolphins.
creators.why: Her work uses play as a way to correct human bias in designing for other species.
creators.role_zh: 马耳他大学数字游戏研究所研究者
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，与一群宽吻海豚共同设计了丰容玩具。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究把玩耍当作纠正人类中心偏见的手段。

creators.name: Mirjana Erceg
creators.role: Researcher, Aalborg University Copenhagen
creators.bio: Researcher who designed a bioacoustic system to warn ships about nearby North Atlantic right whales.
creators.why: Her project uses whales' own calls to change human behaviour at sea.
creators.role_zh: 奥尔堡大学哥本哈根校区研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，设计了一套生物声学系统，在北大西洋露脊鲸靠近时向船只发出警告。
creators.why_zh: 她的项目用鲸自己的叫声来改变人在海上的行为。

creators.name: Fangyuan Chang
creators.role: Researcher, School of Design, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
creators.bio: Design researcher who applies ACI principles to wearable health sensors for dairy cattle.
creators.why: Her case study brings design-led, welfare-first thinking into livestock monitoring.
creators.role_zh: 上海交通大学设计学院研究者
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，把动物-计算机交互的原则用于奶牛的可穿戴健康传感器。
creators.why_zh: 她的案例研究把设计主导、福利优先的思路带进了家畜监测。

creators.name: Oliver Bendel
creators.role: Professor of Information Ethics and Machine Ethics, FHNW School of Business
creators.bio: Philosopher and information scientist who designs animal-friendly machines and AI apps that read animal body language.
creators.why: He builds 'animal-friendly' robots and AI as design cases for machine ethics.
creators.role_zh: 瑞士西北应用科技大学商学院信息伦理与机器伦理教授
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家、信息科学家，设计对动物友好的机器，以及能读取动物肢体语言的人工智能应用。
creators.why_zh: 他把对动物友好的机器人和人工智能当作机器伦理的设计案例来做。

creators.name: Dognosis
creators.role: Research company training dogs to detect cancer by smell, with sensor-rich workstations
creators.bio: Start-up that combines trained detection dogs with sensors and machine learning to screen breath samples for cancer.
creators.why: Its olfactory workstation and suit treat the dog's sniffing as data to be read closely.
creators.role_zh: 训练狗通过嗅觉检测癌症、并配备多传感器工作台的研究公司
creators.bio_zh: 初创公司，把受训的检测犬与传感器和机器学习结合，用于筛查呼气样本中的癌症。
creators.why_zh: 它的嗅觉工作台和传感服把狗的嗅闻本身当作需要细读的数据。

creators.name: Louis Liebenberg
creators.role: Founder, CyberTracker Conservation
creators.bio: Tracker and scientist who co-created CyberTracker so that expert trackers who cannot read or write can record animal observations.
creators.why: CyberTracker turned indigenous tracking knowledge into data for conservation.
creators.role_zh: CyberTracker Conservation 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 追踪者和科学家，共同创建了 CyberTracker，让不识字的追踪专家也能记录动物观察数据。
creators.why_zh: CyberTracker 把原住民的追踪知识变成了保护工作可用的数据。

creators.name: Edwin Blake
creators.role: Professor Emeritus of Computer Science, University of Cape Town
creators.bio: Computer scientist who worked on the icon-based field computer used by CyberTracker and on HCI for development.
creators.why: He documented CyberTracker's icon interface at CHI in 2002, an early animal-related field computer.
creators.role_zh: 开普敦大学计算机科学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，参与了 CyberTracker 基于图标的野外计算机的研究，并从事面向发展中地区的人机交互研究。
creators.why_zh: 他在 2002 年的 CHI 上介绍了 CyberTracker 的图标界面，这是很早期的与动物相关的野外计算机。

creators.name: Jennifer Mankoff
creators.role: Professor, Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering, University of Washington
creators.bio: HCI researcher in accessibility and ubiquitous computing who co-authored an early UIST paper on peripheral displays for a family's dog.
creators.why: PAWSABILITIES (2005) is one of the first interfaces in a major HCI venue that treats a dog as a user.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学保罗·艾伦计算机科学与工程学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究无障碍和普适计算的人机交互学者，曾合著一篇早期 UIST 论文，为家里的狗设计外围显示。
creators.why_zh: PAWSABILITIES（2005）是最早在主要人机交互会议上把狗当作用户的界面之一。

creators.name: Oskar Juhlin
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, Department of Computer and Systems Sciences, Stockholm University
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher who studied GPS-tracked hunting dogs, dog owners' technology and multispecies computer interaction.
creators.why: He co-edited the first journal special issue that framed ACI as a discipline.
creators.role_zh: 斯德哥尔摩大学计算机与系统科学系交互设计教授
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，研究带 GPS 追踪的猎犬、狗主人使用的技术，以及多物种的计算机交互。
creators.why_zh: 他共同主编了第一期把动物-计算机交互定义为一门学科的期刊特刊。

creators.name: Alexandra Weilenmann
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, University of Gothenburg
creators.bio: Ethnographer of mobile technology who studied how hunters use GPS dog-tracking devices in the field.
creators.why: Her study showed how a tracking device changes the interaction between hunters and their dogs.
creators.role_zh: 哥德堡大学交互设计教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究移动技术的民族志学者，观察猎人在野外如何使用 GPS 狗追踪设备。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究展示了追踪设备如何改变猎人与猎犬之间的互动。

creators.name: Carman Neustaedter
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University
creators.bio: HCI researcher on video communication and families who studied pet video chat and guide dog teams.
creators.why: He showed that families want to see and interact with their pets remotely, years before pet cameras became common.
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学交互艺术与技术学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究视频通信与家庭的人机交互学者，研究过宠物视频聊天和导盲犬团队。
creators.why_zh: 早在宠物摄像头普及之前，他就发现家庭希望远程看到宠物并与之互动。

creators.name: Sabrina Hauser
creators.role: Design researcher; PhD, Simon Fraser University
creators.bio: Design researcher who studied the everyday work and play of guide dog teams and designed accessible dog toys.
creators.why: Her study reframed a guide dog team as a partnership whose leisure matters as much as its work.
creators.role_zh: 设计研究者，西蒙菲莎大学博士
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究导盲犬团队日常的工作与玩耍，并设计了无障碍的狗玩具。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究把导盲犬团队看作一种伙伴关系，其闲暇与工作同样重要。

creators.name: Jessica Frawley
creators.role: Researcher, University of Technology Sydney; now The University of Sydney
creators.bio: HCI researcher who adapted personas to represent farm animals in the design of sustainable food systems.
creators.why: Animal personas give non-human stakeholders a place in standard user-centred design tools.
creators.role_zh: 悉尼科技大学研究者，现任职于悉尼大学
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，改造了用户画像方法，在可持续食物系统的设计中代表农场动物。
creators.why_zh: “动物画像”让非人类利益相关者进入了标准的以用户为中心的设计工具。

creators.name: Rui Trindade
creators.role: Researcher, Madeira Interactive Technologies Institute, University of Madeira
creators.bio: Game designer who led Purrfect Crime, a tablet game played by a cat and a person together.
creators.why: An early example of a two-species digital game with asymmetric roles.
creators.role_zh: 马德拉大学马德拉交互技术研究所研究者
creators.bio_zh: 游戏设计者，主导了 Purrfect Crime：一款由猫和人一起玩的平板游戏。
creators.why_zh: 这是早期的双物种、角色不对称的数字游戏之一。

creators.name: Shaun Lawson
creators.role: Professor of Social Computing, Northumbria University; formerly University of Lincoln
creators.bio: HCI researcher who used speculative design to question quantified-pet and 'dog internet' products.
creators.why: His critiques ask who really benefits when pet technology claims to understand animals.
creators.role_zh: 诺森比亚大学社会计算教授，曾任职于林肯大学
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，用思辨设计质疑“量化宠物”和“狗互联网”类产品。
creators.why_zh: 他的批评追问：当宠物技术声称理解动物时，到底谁真正受益。

creators.name: Florian 'Floyd' Mueller
creators.role: Professor, Exertion Games Lab, Monash University; formerly RMIT University
creators.bio: Designer of bodily play and exertion games whose lab also explored remote nurturing play with rescued dogs.
creators.why: The dog project extends his bodily-play research to play between people and animals at a distance.
creators.role_zh: 莫纳什大学 Exertion Games Lab 教授，曾任职于皇家墨尔本理工大学
creators.bio_zh: 身体玩耍与运动游戏的设计者，他的实验室也探索过与救助犬进行远程养育式玩耍。
creators.why_zh: 这个与狗相关的项目把他的身体玩耍研究延伸到了远距离的人与动物之间。

creators.name: Woohun Lee
creators.role: Professor, Department of Industrial Design, KAIST
creators.bio: Industrial design professor whose lab designed BubbleTalk for fishkeeping and MeowPlayLive for cat live streams.
creators.why: His lab designs the human side of human–animal interaction as carefully as the animal side.
creators.role_zh: 韩国科学技术院工业设计系教授
creators.bio_zh: 工业设计教授，他的实验室为养鱼设计了 BubbleTalk，为猫咪直播设计了 MeowPlayLive。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室对人与动物互动中人的一侧和动物的一侧同样用心设计。

creators.name: Ehud Sharlin
creators.role: Professor, Department of Computer Science, University of Calgary
creators.bio: Human–robot interaction researcher whose group observed how house cats react to social robots.
creators.why: His group treats pets as unintended users that robot designers must consider.
creators.role_zh: 卡尔加里大学计算机科学系教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机器人交互研究者，他的团队观察了家猫如何对社交机器人作出反应。
creators.why_zh: 他的团队把宠物看作机器人设计者必须考虑的“非预期用户”。

creators.name: Patrizia Paci
creators.role: Researcher; PhD, The Open University ACI Laboratory
creators.bio: Researcher on the wearability of animal biotelemetry who measured how cats react to commercial GPS trackers.
creators.why: She introduced a wearer-centred design approach for tracking devices worn by animals.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，开放大学动物-计算机交互实验室博士
creators.bio_zh: 研究动物生物遥测设备的可穿戴性，测量了猫对市售 GPS 追踪器的反应。
creators.why_zh: 她为动物佩戴的追踪设备提出了以佩戴者为中心的设计方法。

creators.name: K. Cassie Kresnye
creators.role: Researcher; PhD, Indiana University Bloomington
creators.bio: HCI researcher who designed a smart habitat for rehabilitating orphaned opossums and studied volunteer work at wildlife centres.
creators.why: Her smart habitat reduces human contact with wild animals in care.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，印第安纳大学伯明顿分校博士
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，为救助孤儿负鼠设计了智能栖息箱，并研究野生动物救助中心的志愿者工作。
creators.why_zh: 她的智能栖息箱减少了受救助野生动物与人的接触。

creators.name: Hongyi Zhang
creators.role: Designer, Department of Industrial Design, Xi'an Academy of Fine Arts
creators.bio: Industrial designer who led Meow Meow Call, a prototype for communicating with deaf cats.
creators.why: One of few ACI projects that designs for animals with a disability.
creators.role_zh: 西安美术学院工业设计系设计师
creators.bio_zh: 工业设计师，主导了 Meow Meow Call：一个与失聪猫咪交流的原型。
creators.why_zh: 这是少数为残障动物而设计的动物-计算机交互项目之一。

creators.name: Daniele Quercia
creators.role: Director of Responsible AI, Nokia Bell Labs Cambridge
creators.bio: Computational social scientist whose team built a dog wearable to infer canine personality.
creators.why: Quantified Canine applies personality computing, usually done on people, to dogs.
creators.role_zh: 诺基亚贝尔实验室剑桥负责任人工智能总监
creators.bio_zh: 计算社会科学家，他的团队制作了一种推断狗性格的可穿戴设备。
creators.why_zh: Quantified Canine 把通常用于人的性格计算用在了狗身上。

creators.name: Vilma Kankaanpää
creators.role: PhD researcher, School of Computing Science, University of Glasgow
creators.bio: Researcher who prototypes buttons and audio devices for monkeys, lemurs and giraffes in zoos.
creators.why: Her work adapts rapid prototyping from human HCI to primate and giraffe users.
creators.role_zh: 格拉斯哥大学计算科学学院博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，为动物园里的猴子、狐猴和长颈鹿制作按钮和音频装置的原型。
creators.why_zh: 她把人机交互中的快速原型方法改造给灵长类和长颈鹿使用。

creators.name: Jiaqi Wang
creators.role: PhD researcher, School of Computing Science, University of Glasgow
creators.bio: Researcher who designs multisensory devices that lemurs and zoo visitors can both control.
creators.why: Her lemur devices use smell, sound and sight to reshape how visitors relate to zoo animals.
creators.role_zh: 格拉斯哥大学计算科学学院博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，设计狐猴与动物园游客都能控制的多感官装置。
creators.why_zh: 她为狐猴做的装置用气味、声音和画面重塑游客与动物园动物的关系。

creators.name: Ziming Wang
creators.role: Researcher, t2i Lab, Chalmers University of Technology
creators.bio: HCI researcher who creates speculative designs about biohybrid robots and human–food interaction.
creators.why: His provocations ask what happens when animals are replaced by animal–robot hybrids.
creators.role_zh: 查尔姆斯理工大学 t2i 实验室研究者
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，围绕生物混合机器人与人-食物交互做思辨设计。
creators.why_zh: 他的设计挑衅追问：当动物被动物-机器人混合体取代时会怎样。

creators.name: Hochul Hwang
creators.role: PhD researcher, Manning College of Information and Computer Sciences, University of Massachusetts Amherst
creators.bio: Robotics and HCI researcher who studies handler–guide dog interaction to inform legged guide dog robots.
creators.why: His study starts robot design from what real guide dog teams do.
creators.role_zh: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校曼宁信息与计算机科学学院博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 机器人与人机交互研究者，研究使用者与导盲犬的互动，为四足导盲机器人提供依据。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究从真实导盲犬团队的做法出发来设计机器人。

creators.name: Sena Cucumak
creators.role: Researcher, Futurewell: CoCreation Lab, Media and Visual Arts, Koç University
creators.bio: Design researcher who studies street animals and multispecies cohabitation in Turkish cities.
creators.why: Her urban noticing probes decentre humans in the design of shared streets.
creators.role_zh: 科奇大学媒体与视觉艺术系 Futurewell: CoCreation 实验室研究者
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，研究土耳其城市中的街头动物和多物种共居。
creators.why_zh: 她的“城市注意探针”在共享街道的设计中把人从中心移开。

creators.name: Melanie Ford
creators.role: Primate enrichment researcher; MSc, University of Exeter
creators.bio: Researcher who introduced two captive siamangs to tablet computers and recorded their choices on video.
creators.why: Her showcase documents what small apes choose when given their own technology area.
creators.role_zh: 灵长类丰容研究者，埃克塞特大学硕士
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，为两只圈养合趾猿引入平板电脑，并用视频记录它们的选择。
creators.why_zh: 她的展示记录了小型猿类在拥有自己的技术区域时会选择什么。

creators.name: John Fass
creators.role: Designer and researcher, Royal College of Art
creators.bio: Information designer who ran an open-ended design project on how urban pigeons sense the city.
creators.why: His pigeon project argues that ACI needs open-ended, non-solution-driven experimentation.
creators.role_zh: 皇家艺术学院设计师、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 信息设计师，做了一个关于城市鸽子如何感知城市的开放式设计项目。
creators.why_zh: 他的鸽子项目主张动物-计算机交互需要开放的、不以解决问题为目标的实验。

creators.name: Tim Landgraf
creators.role: Professor of Artificial and Collective Intelligence, Freie Universität Berlin; Dahlem Center for Machine Learning and Robotics
creators.bio: Computer scientist who builds biomimetic robots, RoboFish and RoboBee, that interact with live guppies and honeybees.
creators.why: His robots join animal groups as participants and test how animals communicate.
creators.role_zh: 柏林自由大学人工智能与集体智能教授；达勒姆机器学习与机器人中心
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，制作能与活体孔雀鱼和蜜蜂互动的仿生机器人 RoboFish 和 RoboBee。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人作为参与者加入动物群体，用来检验动物如何交流。

creators.name: Kevin Coffey
creators.role: Neuroscientist, Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences, University of Washington
creators.bio: Researcher who co-created DeepSqueak, deep-learning software that detects and classifies rodent ultrasonic calls.
creators.why: DeepSqueak made the inaudible social calls of rats and mice searchable at scale.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学精神病学与行为科学系神经科学家
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，共同开发了 DeepSqueak：用深度学习检测并分类啮齿动物超声波叫声的软件。
creators.why_zh: DeepSqueak 让大鼠和小鼠人耳听不到的社交叫声可以被大规模检索。

creators.name: CleverPet
creators.role: Company that makes the CleverPet Hub, a puzzle console for dogs
creators.bio: Start-up founded by cognitive scientists from UC San Diego that launched a light-and-sound game console for dogs in 2016.
creators.why: It brought laboratory-style operant learning tasks into home dog enrichment.
creators.role_zh: 制作狗用益智游戏机 CleverPet Hub 的公司
creators.bio_zh: 由加州大学圣迭戈分校的认知科学家创办的初创公司，2016 年推出一款用光和声音玩的狗用游戏机。
creators.why_zh: 它把实验室式的操作性学习任务带进了家庭中的狗丰容。

creators.name: Nestlé Purina PetCare
creators.role: Pet food company; maker of the Friskies brand
creators.bio: Pet food company whose Friskies brand released tablet games designed for cats to play.
creators.why: Games for Cats made touchscreen play for cats a mass-market idea.
creators.role_zh: 宠物食品公司，Friskies 品牌所有者
creators.bio_zh: 宠物食品公司，旗下 Friskies 品牌发布了专为猫设计的平板游戏。
creators.why_zh: Games for Cats 让猫玩触摸屏成为大众都知道的想法。

creators.name: Halter
creators.role: Agricultural technology company making solar-powered virtual-fencing collars for cattle
creators.bio: Company founded in 2016 whose GPS collars guide cattle with sound and vibration cues instead of physical fences.
creators.why: Halter is a large-scale case of animals learning to follow a computer interface every day.
creators.role_zh: 为牛制作太阳能虚拟围栏项圈的农业科技公司
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2016 年的公司，用 GPS 项圈通过声音和振动提示引导牛群，而不再依赖实体围栏。
creators.why_zh: Halter 是动物每天学习跟随计算机界面的大规模案例。

creators.name: Lely
creators.role: Dutch agricultural machinery and robotics manufacturer
creators.bio: Company that introduced the Astronaut milking robot in 1992, in which cows choose when to be milked.
creators.why: Voluntary milking made cows the ones who start a human–machine interaction.
creators.role_zh: 荷兰农业机械与机器人制造商
creators.bio_zh: 1992 年推出 Astronaut 挤奶机器人的公司，奶牛可以自己选择何时去挤奶。
creators.why_zh: 自愿挤奶让奶牛成为人机交互的发起者。

creators.name: Beewise
creators.role: Company that makes the BeeHome, a robotic, solar-powered beehive
creators.bio: Start-up founded in 2018 that automates beekeeping with cameras, AI and a robotic arm inside a hive container.
creators.why: It turns hive care into continuous machine monitoring of a colony.
creators.role_zh: 制作太阳能机器人蜂箱 BeeHome 的公司
creators.bio_zh: 2018 年成立的初创公司，用摄像头、人工智能和蜂箱内的机械臂自动化养蜂。
creators.why_zh: 它把照料蜂箱变成了机器对蜂群的持续监测。

creators.name: Open Acoustic Devices
creators.role: Open-hardware project making low-cost acoustic loggers, founded by researchers at the University of Southampton and University of Oxford
creators.bio: Team behind AudioMoth, an open-source, low-cost recorder used worldwide to listen to bats, birds, insects and forests.
creators.why: AudioMoth made large-scale acoustic monitoring of wildlife affordable.
creators.role_zh: 由南安普顿大学和牛津大学研究者创立、制作低成本声学记录器的开源硬件项目
creators.bio_zh: AudioMoth 的开发团队。AudioMoth 是一款开源的低成本录音器，在全球被用来监听蝙蝠、鸟类、昆虫和森林。
creators.why_zh: AudioMoth 让大规模的野生动物声学监测变得负担得起。

creators.name: Benioff Ocean Science Laboratory
creators.role: Ocean science lab at the University of California, Santa Barbara
creators.bio: Lab that built Whale Safe, a system combining acoustic whale detection, models and ship tracking to reduce ship strikes.
creators.why: Whale Safe connects whale presence to ship behaviour in near real time.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校的海洋科学实验室
creators.bio_zh: 开发 Whale Safe 的实验室。Whale Safe 结合鲸类声学探测、模型和船舶追踪来减少船撞鲸事件。
creators.why_zh: Whale Safe 把鲸的出现与船的行为几乎实时地联系起来。

creators.name: Martin Wikelski
creators.role: Director, Max Planck Institute of Animal Behavior
creators.bio: Ornithologist who leads ICARUS and Movebank, global systems for tracking small animals from space.
creators.why: He frames animal tracking as an 'Internet of Animals' in which animals act as sensors of the planet.
creators.role_zh: 马克斯·普朗克动物行为研究所所长
creators.bio_zh: 鸟类学家，领导 ICARUS 和 Movebank 这两个从太空追踪小型动物的全球系统。
creators.why_zh: 他把动物追踪设想为“动物互联网”：动物本身成为地球的传感器。

creators.name: Greg Marshall
creators.role: Marine biologist and filmmaker; inventor of Crittercam at National Geographic
creators.bio: Biologist who invented Crittercam in 1986, a camera and data logger worn by animals, and developed it at National Geographic.
creators.why: Crittercam let viewers and scientists see the world from the animal's own position.
creators.role_zh: 海洋生物学家、电影人；在美国国家地理学会发明了 Crittercam
creators.bio_zh: 生物学家，1986 年发明了由动物佩戴的摄像与数据记录装置 Crittercam，并在美国国家地理学会持续开发。
creators.why_zh: Crittercam 让观众和科学家从动物自己的位置看世界。

creators.name: Nordic Society for Invention and Discovery
creators.role: Swedish design and invention studio
creators.bio: Studio that crowdfunded No More Woof, a speculative EEG headset claimed to translate dog thoughts into speech.
creators.why: No More Woof shows public appetite for 'pet translators' and the gap to what science can do.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典的设计与发明工作室
creators.bio_zh: 通过众筹推出 No More Woof 的工作室，这是一款宣称能把狗的想法翻译成人话的思辨性脑电头戴设备。
creators.why_zh: No More Woof 显示了公众对“宠物翻译器”的渴望，以及它与科学实际能力之间的差距。

creators.name: B. F. Skinner
creators.role: Psychologist (1904–1990), Harvard University
creators.bio: Behaviourist who developed operant conditioning and, in World War II, trained pigeons to peck at screen images to steer a guided bomb.
creators.why: Project Pigeon is an early and uneasy example of animals operating a computing interface.
creators.role_zh: 心理学家（1904–1990），哈佛大学
creators.bio_zh: 行为主义心理学家，提出操作性条件反射；二战期间训练鸽子啄击屏幕上的图像来操纵制导炸弹。
creators.why_zh: “鸽子计划”是动物操作计算界面的早期案例，也令人不安。

creators.name: Duane Rumbaugh
creators.role: Comparative psychologist (1929–2017), Yerkes National Primate Research Center and Georgia State University
creators.bio: Psychologist who led the LANA project, in which a chimpanzee used a computer keyboard of lexigram symbols.
creators.why: The Yerkish lexigram keyboard was one of the first computer interfaces designed for another species.
creators.role_zh: 比较心理学家（1929–2017），耶基斯国家灵长类研究中心、佐治亚州立大学
creators.bio_zh: 心理学家，领导了 LANA 项目：让一只黑猩猩使用由词符（lexigram）组成的计算机键盘。
creators.why_zh: Yerkish 词符键盘是最早为其他物种设计的计算机界面之一。

creators.name: Diana Reiss
creators.role: Professor of Psychology, Hunter College, City University of New York
creators.bio: Cognitive psychologist who built an underwater keyboard for dolphins in the 1980s and later co-founded the Interspecies Internet.
creators.why: Her dolphin keyboard let dolphins choose objects and activities and learn sounds for them.
creators.role_zh: 纽约市立大学亨特学院心理学教授
creators.bio_zh: 认知心理学家，1980 年代为海豚制作了水下键盘，后来共同发起了 Interspecies Internet。
creators.why_zh: 她的海豚键盘让海豚可以选择物品和活动，并学会与之对应的声音。

creators.name: Orangutan Outreach
creators.role: Nonprofit organisation for orangutan conservation
creators.bio: Nonprofit that runs Apps for Apes, which donates iPads to zoos for orangutan enrichment.
creators.why: Apps for Apes spread tablet enrichment for orangutans across many zoos.
creators.role_zh: 红毛猩猩保护非营利组织
creators.bio_zh: 运营 Apps for Apes 项目的非营利组织，向动物园捐赠 iPad 用于红毛猩猩丰容。
creators.why_zh: Apps for Apes 让红毛猩猩的平板丰容推广到了许多动物园。

creators.name: Federico Rossano
creators.role: Associate Professor, Department of Cognitive Science, University of California San Diego; director of the Comparative Cognition Lab
creators.bio: Cognitive scientist who leads the largest study of dogs that press soundboard buttons, such as FluentPet boards.
creators.why: His lab tests, with controlled experiments, whether 'talking' button dogs mean what they press.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣迭戈分校认知科学系副教授，比较认知实验室主任
creators.bio_zh: 认知科学家，主持规模最大的“按按钮说话的狗”研究（如 FluentPet 按钮板）。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室用对照实验检验这些“会说话的狗”按下的按钮是否真有含义。

creators.name: FluentPet
creators.role: Pet technology company making programmable soundboard buttons
creators.bio: Company that makes recordable buttons and hexagonal tiles that dogs and cats press to play words.
creators.why: FluentPet turned an augmentative communication idea into a home product used by many dog owners.
creators.role_zh: 制作可编程语音按钮板的宠物科技公司
creators.bio_zh: 公司，生产可录音的按钮和六边形底板，狗和猫按下按钮就会播放单词。
creators.why_zh: FluentPet 把辅助沟通的想法变成了许多狗主人家里使用的产品。

creators.name: DOGTV
creators.role: Television network made for dogs
creators.bio: Network founded in 2012 whose programmes are edited for dogs' colour vision, hearing and home-alone hours.
creators.why: DOGTV is a commercial case of media designed for a non-human audience.
creators.role_zh: 专为狗制作的电视网
creators.bio_zh: 2012 年创立的电视网，节目依据狗的色觉、听觉和独自在家的时段来剪辑。
creators.why_zh: DOGTV 是为非人类观众设计媒体的商业案例。

creators.name: Clemens Driessen
creators.role: Philosopher, Wageningen University
creators.bio: Philosopher of technology and animal ethics who co-created Pig Chase, a game played between pigs and people.
creators.why: Pig Chase asks whether play can change how people see pigs in industrial farming.
creators.role_zh: 瓦赫宁根大学哲学家
creators.bio_zh: 技术哲学与动物伦理学者，共同创作了猪与人一起玩的游戏 Pig Chase。
creators.why_zh: Pig Chase 追问：玩耍能否改变人们如何看待工业化养殖中的猪。

creators.name: Kars Alfrink
creators.role: Designer; founder of the studio Hubbub; researcher at TU Delft
creators.bio: Game designer who co-created Pig Chase and works on contestable AI and urban play.
creators.why: He designed the touch-screen game mechanics that let pigs and people play at a distance.
creators.role_zh: 设计师，Hubbub 工作室创始人，代尔夫特理工大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 游戏设计师，共同创作了 Pig Chase，并研究可质询的人工智能和城市游戏。
creators.why_zh: 他设计了让猪和人隔空一起玩的触屏游戏机制。

works.title: Who Is Really In The Center Of Dog Computer Design?
works.description: A position paper asking whether HCI methods such as co-design and grounded theory can move from human users to dogs, and who really sits at the centre of 'dog-centred' design.
works.description_zh: 一篇立场论文：追问共同设计、扎根理论等人机交互方法能否从人类用户转用到狗身上，以及“以狗为中心”的设计里真正处在中心的是谁。
works.idea_en: Before borrowing HCI methods for animals, check whose needs the method actually serves.
works.idea_zh: 在把人机交互方法借给动物之前，先看清这种方法实际服务的是谁的需要。
works.method: A review of HCI's history of user involvement, mapped onto dog–computer design practices.
works.method_zh: 回顾人机交互让用户参与的历史，并对照到狗与计算机的设计实践上。

paper.title: Who Is Really In The Center Of Dog Computer Design?

works.title: Ethical issues and guidelines when conducting HCI studies with animals
works.description: A literature-based set of ethical guidelines for HCI studies that involve animals, covering planning, running and reporting such studies.
works.description_zh: 一套基于文献的伦理指南，面向涉及动物的人机交互研究，涵盖研究的规划、执行和报告。
works.idea_en: Studies with animals need their own ethics checklist, not a copy of human-participant rules.
works.idea_zh: 与动物一起做研究，需要自己的伦理清单，而不是照搬人类受试者的规则。
works.method: A review of animal-research ethics and welfare literature condensed into phase-by-phase guidelines for HCI researchers.
works.method_zh: 把动物研究伦理和福利文献浓缩成按研究阶段划分的人机交互研究指南。

paper.title: Ethical issues and guidelines when conducting HCI studies with animals

works.title: Exploring Research through Design in Animal Computer Interaction
works.description: Argues that research through design helps ACI researchers explore situations where no established way of interacting with an animal yet exists, drawing on elephant enrichment prototypes.
works.description_zh: 论文主张：在人与动物之间还不存在既定交互方式的情境里，“通过设计做研究”能帮助动物-计算机交互研究者展开探索，并以大象丰容原型为例。
works.idea_en: When no interaction idiom exists for a species, making prototypes is how you find one.
works.idea_zh: 当一个物种还没有现成的交互惯例时，做原型就是找到它的方法。
works.method: Reflection on iterative prototyping of interactive toys with zoo elephants, framed by research-through-design literature.
works.method_zh: 以“通过设计做研究”的文献为框架，反思为动物园大象反复制作互动玩具原型的过程。

paper.title: Exploring Research through Design in Animal Computer Interaction

works.title: A Method for Evaluating Animal Usability (MEAU)
works.description: Proposes MEAU, a method for evaluating how usable an interface is for an animal user, by reading the animal's behaviour against its species' capabilities.
works.description_zh: 提出 MEAU：一种评估界面对动物用户是否好用的方法，依据该物种的能力来解读动物的行为。
works.idea_en: Usability can be measured for a dog, if you know what its behaviour means.
works.idea_zh: 只要懂得狗的行为意味着什么，就可以衡量一个界面对狗的可用性。
works.method: Combines usability constructs from HCI with ethological behaviour coding, tested on dogs using interfaces.
works.method_zh: 把人机交互中的可用性概念与动物行为学编码结合起来，在使用界面的狗身上加以检验。

paper.title: A Method for Evaluating Animal Usability (MEAU)

works.title: Reflecting on Methods in Animal Computer Interaction: Novelty Effect and Habituation
works.description: Examines why animals often use a new device eagerly and then lose interest, linking HCI's novelty effect with habituation from animal behaviour science.
works.description_zh: 探讨为什么动物常常一开始热衷使用新装置、随后失去兴趣，把人机交互中的“新奇效应”与动物行为学中的“习惯化”联系起来。
works.idea_en: A drop in use is not failure; design and evaluate for the long tail after novelty fades.
works.idea_zh: 使用率下降不等于失败；要为新鲜感消退之后的长期使用来设计和评估。
works.method: Analysis of three ACI enrichment deployments (including monkeys and orangutans) through the lenses of novelty and habituation.
works.method_zh: 从新奇效应和习惯化的角度分析三个动物-计算机交互丰容项目（包括猴子和红毛猩猩）。

paper.title: Reflecting on Methods in Animal Computer Interaction: Novelty Effect and Habituation

works.title: Animal-centered design needs dignity: a critical essay on ACI’s core concept
works.description: A critical essay arguing that 'animal-centred' has come to mean 'animal user-centred', and that ACI should ground its core concept in animal dignity.
works.description_zh: 一篇批判性文章：认为“以动物为中心”已被等同于“以动物用户为中心”，主张动物-计算机交互应以动物的尊严作为核心概念的基础。
works.idea_en: Being a good user experience for an animal is not the same as respecting the animal.
works.idea_zh: 给动物好的使用体验，并不等于尊重这只动物。
works.method: Conceptual analysis of the ACI manifesto and later work, drawing on value-sensitive design and animal ethics.
works.method_zh: 借助价值敏感设计与动物伦理，对动物-计算机交互宣言及后续研究进行概念分析。

paper.title: Animal-centered design needs dignity: a critical essay on ACI’s core concept

works.title: Politicising Animal-Computer Interaction: an Approach to Political Engagement with Animal-Centred Design
works.description: Argues that ACI projects operate inside socio-economic systems that are not animal-centred, and proposes a political approach to animal-centred design.
works.description_zh: 论文指出，动物-计算机交互项目运行于并不以动物为中心的社会经济体系之中，并提出一种政治化的以动物为中心的设计方法。
works.idea_en: Designing for one animal's needs can reinforce the system that harms many; design has politics.
works.idea_zh: 只满足一只动物的需要，可能会强化伤害更多动物的体系；设计本身带有政治性。
works.method: Draws on political interaction design literature to reframe ACI goals and researcher responsibilities.
works.method_zh: 借助政治性交互设计的文献，重新界定动物-计算机交互的目标和研究者的责任。

paper.title: Politicising Animal-Computer Interaction: an Approach to Political Engagement with Animal-Centred Design

works.title: Watching Animal-Computer Interaction: Effects on Perceptions of Animal Intellect
works.description: Studies whether seeing orangutans use a digital enrichment installation changes zoo visitors' views of orangutan intelligence and support for conservation.
works.description_zh: 研究游客看到红毛猩猩使用数字丰容装置后，对红毛猩猩智力的看法和对保护工作的支持是否会改变。
works.idea_en: Animal–computer interaction also acts on the humans who watch it.
works.idea_zh: 动物-计算机交互同样作用于在一旁观看的人。
works.method: Visitor interviews and a survey at Melbourne Zoo comparing attitudes with and without the installation in use.
works.method_zh: 在墨尔本动物园通过游客访谈和问卷，比较装置在用与不在用时游客的态度差异。

paper.title: Watching Animal-Computer Interaction: Effects on Perceptions of Animal Intellect

works.title: The Day After: Ethical Considerations for the End of Enriching Animal Research Projects
works.description: Discusses what happens to animals when a research project that gave them enriching technology ends and the devices are taken away.
works.description_zh: 讨论当一个为动物提供丰富化技术的研究项目结束、设备被撤走时，动物会面临什么。
works.idea_en: Plan the end of an animal study as carefully as its start.
works.idea_zh: 要像规划开始一样，认真规划动物研究的结束。
works.method: Ethical analysis grounded in long-term parrot tablet studies, proposing obligations for project closure.
works.method_zh: 以长期的鹦鹉平板研究为基础进行伦理分析，提出项目收尾时的责任。

paper.title: The Day After: Ethical Considerations for the End of Enriching Animal Research Projects

works.title: Animals' Entanglement with Technology: a Scoping Review
works.description: A scoping review of nearly 800 works on how animals meet technology, whether it is designed for them, with them or only around them.
works.description_zh: 一篇综述，梳理近 800 项研究，看动物如何与技术相遇，无论这些技术是为它们设计、与它们一起设计，还是只是存在于它们周围。
works.idea_en: Most technology animals meet was never designed for them; ACI has to study that too.
works.idea_zh: 动物遇到的大多数技术从来不是为它们设计的；动物-计算机交互也必须研究这一部分。
works.method: Systematic coding of research objectives, technology types and animal contexts across HCI and neighbouring fields.
works.method_zh: 对人机交互及相关领域研究的目标、技术类型和动物情境进行系统编码。

paper.title: Animals' Entanglement with Technology: a Scoping Review

works.title: Animal personas: acknowledging non-human stakeholders in designing for sustainable food systems
works.description: Adapts personas, a standard user-centred design tool, to represent farm animals alongside farmers when designing for co-operative and sustainable food systems.
works.description_zh: 改造了以用户为中心设计中常用的“用户画像”，在为合作式、可持续的食物系统做设计时，让农场动物与农民一起被代表。
works.idea_en: Give animals a persona and they enter the design brief.
works.idea_zh: 给动物做一份用户画像，它们就进入了设计需求。
works.method: Personas for livestock built from farming philosophy and animal needs, used in a design process for a food co-operative.
works.method_zh: 依据养殖理念和动物需要为家畜建立用户画像，并在食品合作社的设计过程中使用。

paper.title: Animal personas: acknowledging non-human stakeholders in designing for sustainable food systems

works.title: Problematising Upstream Technology through Speculative Design: The Case of Quantified Cats and Dogs
works.description: Uses speculative pet-tracking product concepts to ask pet owners and animal experts about 'quantified' cats and dogs.
works.description_zh: 用一组思辨性的宠物追踪产品概念，向宠物主人和动物专家询问他们对“量化”猫狗的看法。
works.idea_en: Show speculative products before they are built to surface what might go wrong.
works.idea_zh: 在产品真正被造出来之前，先拿思辨设计去暴露可能出错的地方。
works.method: Speculative design concepts presented in an online study with owners and in interviews with animal behaviour experts.
works.method_zh: 在面向宠物主人的在线研究和动物行为专家访谈中展示思辨设计概念。

paper.title: Problematising Upstream Technology through Speculative Design: The Case of Quantified Cats and Dogs

works.title: Power, participation, and the dog internet
works.description: An essay on the rise of 'dog internet' products that promise to translate tail wags and barks, and on who holds power in these systems.
works.description_zh: 一篇文章，讨论那些声称能翻译摇尾和吠叫的“狗互联网”产品的兴起，以及在这些系统中谁掌握权力。
works.idea_en: Pet tech often speaks for the animal without letting it speak.
works.idea_zh: 宠物科技常常替动物说话，却不让动物自己说话。
works.method: Critical reading of commercial pet devices and apps, drawing on participatory design ideas about power.
works.method_zh: 借助参与式设计中关于权力的观点，批判性地解读市售宠物设备和应用。

paper.title: Power, participation, and the dog internet

works.title: ZooJamming: Designing Beyond Human Experience
works.description: Reports on three ZooJams, game-jam-style workshops at the ACI conference where mixed teams design enrichment for zoo animals to real briefs.
works.description_zh: 报告在动物-计算机交互会议上举办的三次 ZooJam：类似游戏马拉松的工作坊，跨学科团队按真实需求为动物园动物设计丰容方案。
works.idea_en: A game-jam format gets zoo experts and designers prototyping for animals in a day.
works.idea_zh: 游戏马拉松的形式能让动物园专家和设计师在一天之内为动物做出原型。
works.method: Jam format with keeper-written briefs, rapid ideation and crafted prototypes, reflected on by the organisers.
works.method_zh: 采用饲养员撰写需求、快速构思和手工原型的工作坊形式，并由组织者进行反思。

paper.title: ZooJamming: Designing Beyond Human Experience

works.title: Concept Craft Cards: Deck of theoretical and practical suggestions for ACI developers
works.description: A deck of Concept Craft Cards that gives ACI developers conceptual, experiential and practical prompts for designing enrichment for non-human clients.
works.description_zh: 一套 Concept Craft Cards 卡片，为动物-计算机交互开发者提供从概念、体验到实践层面的提示，用于为非人类“客户”设计丰容。
works.idea_en: A card deck can carry animal-centred principles into everyday design sessions.
works.idea_zh: 一副卡片就能把以动物为中心的原则带进日常的设计讨论。
works.method: Cards organised in levels, from design philosophy to sensory topics, used against non-human client briefs.
works.method_zh: 卡片按层级组织，从设计理念到感官主题，配合非人类客户的设计需求使用。

paper.title: Concept Craft Cards: Deck of theoretical and practical suggestions for ACI developers

works.title: Ethics and Power Dynamics in Playful Technology for Animals: Using speculative design to provoke reflection
works.description: A workshop that used speculative design to debate the ethics and power relations of playful technology for animals.
works.description_zh: 一次工作坊：用思辨设计讨论面向动物的游戏化技术所涉及的伦理与权力关系。
works.idea_en: Speculating about animal play devices exposes who controls the game.
works.idea_zh: 对动物游戏装置的思辨，会暴露出到底是谁在掌控这场游戏。
works.method: Participants designed speculative interspecies play systems and discussed their implications.
works.method_zh: 参与者设计思辨性的跨物种游戏系统，并讨论其影响。

paper.title: Ethics and Power Dynamics in Playful Technology for Animals: Using speculative design to provoke reflection

works.title: Seven Years after the Manifesto: Literature Review and Research Directions for Technologies in Animal Computer Interaction
works.description: A literature review of technologies built for animals in the seven years after the ACI manifesto: tangible, haptic, wearable, olfactory, screen and tracking systems.
works.description_zh: 一篇文献综述，梳理动物-计算机交互宣言发表后七年间为动物开发的技术：可触摸、触觉、可穿戴、嗅觉、屏幕和追踪系统。
works.idea_en: A map of what has been built for animals shows where interaction design for them is still thin.
works.idea_zh: 一张“为动物造过什么”的地图，能看出哪些方向的动物交互设计仍然薄弱。
works.method: Thematic review organised by interaction modality, with research directions for each.
works.method_zh: 按交互模态组织的主题综述，并为每类技术提出研究方向。

paper.title: Seven Years after the Manifesto: Literature Review and Research Directions for Technologies in Animal Computer Interaction

works.title: Welfare Through Competence: A Framework for Animal-Centric Technology Design
works.description: Proposes 'Welfare through Competence', a framework that guides animal technology design by the skills and behaviours an animal needs to use and develop.
works.description_zh: 提出“以能力促福利”框架：以动物需要使用和发展的技能与行为来指导动物技术的设计。
works.idea_en: Design technology that lets animals exercise their competences, and welfare follows.
works.idea_zh: 设计让动物施展自身能力的技术，福利自然随之而来。
works.method: Framework built from animal welfare science and ACI practice, applied to zoos, farms, shelters and kennels.
works.method_zh: 基于动物福利科学和动物-计算机交互实践构建框架，并应用于动物园、农场、收容所和犬舍。

paper.title: Welfare Through Competence: A Framework for Animal-Centric Technology Design

works.title: Animal-Computer Interaction: The emergence of a discipline
works.description: The editorial to the first journal special issue on Animal–Computer Interaction, outlining the field's aims, challenges and community.
works.description_zh: 第一期动物-计算机交互期刊特刊的编者按，概述了该领域的目标、挑战和研究社群。
works.idea_en: ACI became a discipline once it had shared aims and a venue to argue about them.
works.idea_zh: 当有了共同目标和可以争论这些目标的平台，动物-计算机交互才成为一门学科。
works.method: Overview of the state of the art and introduction to the special issue papers in IJHCS.
works.method_zh: 综述领域现状，并介绍《国际人机研究期刊》特刊收录的论文。

paper.title: Animal-Computer Interaction: The emergence of a discipline

works.title: An Ethics Toolkit to Support Animal-Centered Research and Design
works.description: An ethics toolkit of worksheets that helps researchers and designers reflect on their assumptions and responsibilities when animals take part in their work.
works.description_zh: 一套由工作表组成的伦理工具包，帮助研究者和设计者在动物参与项目时反思自身的假设与责任。
works.idea_en: Ethics for animal participants works better as a practice you do than a rule you check.
works.idea_zh: 对动物参与者的伦理，作为一种实践比作为一条要核对的规则更有效。
works.method: Structured prompts on the researcher's understanding of the animal, its role and the researcher's own role, used before and during projects.
works.method_zh: 围绕研究者对动物的理解、动物的角色以及研究者自身角色设计结构化提示，在项目开始前和进行中使用。

paper.title: An Ethics Toolkit to Support Animal-Centered Research and Design

works.title: Substituting Animals with Biohybrid Robots: Speculative Interactions with Animal-Robot Hybrids
works.description: A speculative concept in which animals are replaced by biohybrid robots that people assemble and eat, used to provoke debate about food and animal futures.
works.description_zh: 一个思辨设计概念：动物被生物混合机器人取代，人们组装并食用它们，借此引发关于食物与动物未来的讨论。
works.idea_en: If robots replace animals on our plates, what do we still owe to either?
works.idea_zh: 如果机器人取代了餐盘上的动物，我们对两者各自还有什么亏欠？
works.method: Design fiction and provocation drawing on developments in biohybrid robotics and human–food interaction.
works.method_zh: 借助生物混合机器人和人-食物交互的发展进行设计虚构与挑衅。

paper.title: Substituting Animals with Biohybrid Robots: Speculative Interactions with Animal-Robot Hybrids

works.title: De-computing the pigeon sensorium
works.description: An open-ended design project on how urban pigeons sense the city, arguing that non-goal-driven experiments can open new directions for ACI.
works.description_zh: 一个开放式设计项目，探索城市鸽子如何感知城市，主张不以解决问题为目标的实验能为动物-计算机交互打开新方向。
works.idea_en: Start from the animal's senses, not from a problem to solve.
works.idea_zh: 从动物的感官出发，而不是从一个待解决的问题出发。
works.method: Design experiments and artefacts exploring pigeon perception of urban space.
works.method_zh: 通过设计实验和物件探索鸽子对城市空间的感知。

paper.title: De-computing the pigeon sensorium

works.title: Opportunities for ACI in PLF: Applying Animal- and User-Centred Design to Precision Livestock Farming
works.description: Argues that precision livestock farming, which grew out of engineering, should adopt animal- and user-centred design methods from ACI.
works.description_zh: 论文主张：源自工程领域的精准畜牧业应当吸收动物-计算机交互中以动物和用户为中心的设计方法。
works.idea_en: Farm sensors are designed for animals too; involve them and farmers in the process.
works.idea_zh: 农场传感器同样是为动物设计的；设计过程应当让动物和农民都参与进来。
works.method: Comparison of PLF and ACI literature with design opportunities for livestock technology.
works.method_zh: 对比精准畜牧业和动物-计算机交互的文献，提出家畜技术的设计机会。

paper.title: Opportunities for ACI in PLF: Applying Animal- and User-Centred Design to Precision Livestock Farming

works.title: A dog using skype
works.description: A trainer describes teaching a dog to respond correctly to an owner's verbal cues given over a video call.
works.description_zh: 一位训犬师讲述如何训练狗正确回应主人通过视频通话发出的口令。
works.idea_en: Dogs can learn to treat a screen voice as their owner.
works.idea_zh: 狗可以学会把屏幕里的声音当作主人。
works.method: Stepwise training with video chat software until the dog followed cues from a remote owner.
works.method_zh: 借助视频聊天软件分步训练，直到狗能执行远程主人的指令。

paper.title: A dog using skype

works.title: AquaPrism: Dynamically Altering the Color of Aquatic Animals without Injury by Augmenting Aquarium
works.description: AquaPrism makes translucent aquarium animals appear coloured and glowing in the dark without dyes or injury, using polarised light behind a normal tank.
works.description_zh: AquaPrism 不使用染料、不伤害动物，而是在普通鱼缸后方利用偏振光，让透明的水族动物在黑暗中呈现颜色和光泽。
works.idea_en: Change how an animal looks by designing the light, not the animal.
works.idea_zh: 改变动物的外观，要设计光线，而不是改造动物。
works.method: Polarising sheets on the front and back of the tank darken it; the birefringent bodies of translucent animals rotate polarised light from a monitor and show colour.
works.method_zh: 在鱼缸前后贴偏振片让鱼缸变暗；透明动物身体的双折射会旋转来自显示器的偏振光，从而显出颜色。

paper.title: AquaPrism: Dynamically Altering the Color of Aquatic Animals without Injury by Augmenting Aquarium

works.title: Dogs using touchscreens in the home: a case study for assistance dogs operating emergency notification systems
works.description: Medical alert dogs were trained to operate wall-mounted touchscreens at home to call for help in an emergency.
works.description_zh: 训练医疗警报犬操作安装在家中墙上的触摸屏，在紧急情况下呼叫帮助。
works.idea_en: An assistance dog without its vest still needs an interface; put it on the wall.
works.idea_zh: 没穿工作背心的辅助犬也需要一个界面；那就把它装在墙上。
works.method: Home field study with three medical alert dogs performing a specific touch pattern on randomly timed virtual targets.
works.method_zh: 在家中开展实地研究，三只医疗警报犬在随机时间出现的虚拟目标上完成特定的触碰顺序。

paper.title: Dogs using touchscreens in the home: a case study for assistance dogs operating emergency notification systems

works.title: WOOFlex: A Wearable Device to Aid Canine Flexibility Exercises
works.description: WOOFlex is a wearable for dogs that measures joint angles during stretching exercises and gives the owner real-time feedback.
works.description_zh: WOOFlex 是一款狗用可穿戴设备，在伸展训练中测量关节角度，并为主人提供实时反馈。
works.idea_en: Put the measuring device on the dog so the person's hands stay free for the exercise.
works.idea_zh: 把测量设备穿在狗身上，人的双手就能专心做训练。
works.method: Flex sensors in a fitted sleeve read joint range of motion and compare it with breed-specific targets in an app.
works.method_zh: 贴合的套袖里装有弯曲传感器，读取关节活动度，并在应用中与该品种的目标值比较。

paper.title: WOOFlex: A Wearable Device to Aid Canine Flexibility Exercises

works.title: cirCAT: PURRtentio: a Litter Box that Monitors Feline Urine using Electrochemical Biosensors
works.description: cirCAT: PURRtentio is a litter box with an electrochemical biosensor that analyses a cat's urine at home each time it is used.
works.description_zh: cirCAT: PURRtentio 是一个装有电化学生物传感器的猫砂盆，猫每次使用时都能在家分析它的尿液。
works.idea_en: Turn a daily habit, using the litter box, into health monitoring without a vet visit.
works.idea_zh: 把每天上厕所的习惯变成健康监测，不必专门去看兽医。
works.method: A DIY three-electrode sensor, potentiostat, microcontroller and distance sensor detect the cat and measure urine analytes, shown in a mobile app.
works.method_zh: 自制三电极传感器、恒电位仪、微控制器和距离传感器识别猫并测量尿液成分，结果在手机应用中显示。

paper.title: cirCAT: PURRtentio: a Litter Box that Monitors Feline Urine using Electrochemical Biosensors

works.title: GluCAT: A Feline Biofluids IoT Hub for Electrochemical Glucose Biosensing
works.description: GluCAT is a 'feline biofluids IoT hub' that senses glucose in cat urine with an electrochemical biosensor and links the data to connected home devices.
works.description_zh: GluCAT 是一个“猫体液物联网中枢”，用电化学生物传感器检测猫尿中的葡萄糖，并把数据连接到家中的联网设备。
works.idea_en: A pet's body fluids can become a data stream for its care.
works.idea_zh: 宠物的体液可以成为照护它的数据流。
works.method: Glucose biosensing in a litter-box setup, integrated with an IoT system for continuous monitoring.
works.method_zh: 在猫砂盆装置中进行葡萄糖生物传感，并接入物联网系统做持续监测。

paper.title: GluCAT: A Feline Biofluids IoT Hub for Electrochemical Glucose Biosensing

works.title: pawH: Colorimetric pH-Sensing Toys for Non-Invasive Pet Health Monitoring
works.description: pawH are pet toys, a braided rope and a ball, that change colour with the pH of the pet's saliva as it chews.
works.description_zh: pawH 是一组宠物玩具（编织绳和球），会随宠物咀嚼时唾液的 pH 值改变颜色。
works.idea_en: A chew toy can be a diagnostic strip the animal applies by playing.
works.idea_zh: 咬咬玩具也可以是一张由动物自己在玩耍中“涂抹”的检测试纸。
works.method: Colorimetric pH biosensors embedded in pet-safe toy materials; colour read by eye or with a portable spectrometer.
works.method_zh: 把比色法 pH 生物传感材料嵌入对宠物安全的玩具中，颜色可用肉眼或便携光谱仪读取。

paper.title: pawH: Colorimetric pH-Sensing Toys for Non-Invasive Pet Health Monitoring

works.title: KitBit: An Instrumented Collar for Indoor Pets
works.description: KitBit is a light collar-mounted activity tracker for indoor cats that classifies their activity level with machine learning.
works.description_zh: KitBit 是一款轻巧的项圈式活动追踪器，为室内猫设计，用机器学习判断它们的活动水平。
works.idea_en: Design pet trackers for cats' bodies and homes, not as shrunken dog trackers.
works.idea_zh: 为猫的身体和居家环境设计追踪器，而不是把狗用追踪器缩小。
works.method: IMU on the collar with wireless transmission; an LSTM model classifies activity from play sessions in 11 homes.
works.method_zh: 项圈上的惯性测量单元无线传输数据；LSTM 模型根据 11 个家庭中的玩耍数据判断活动水平。

paper.title: KitBit: An Instrumented Collar for Indoor Pets

works.title: Prototyping an Immersive Screen Interfaces for Dogs' to Control Screens in Their Home
works.description: A home system that lets a dog switch on videos on an immersive screen setup, studied over six months with one dog.
works.description_zh: 一个家用系统：让狗自己在沉浸式屏幕装置上开启视频，研究者对一只狗进行了六个月的观察。
works.idea_en: Give the dog the remote and see what it actually wants to watch.
works.idea_zh: 把遥控器交给狗，看看它真正想看什么。
works.method: Dog-triggered video playback with logging of attention and content features over a long home deployment.
works.method_zh: 由狗触发视频播放，并在长期居家部署中记录注意力和内容特征。

paper.title: Prototyping an Immersive Screen Interfaces for Dogs' to Control Screens in Their Home

works.title: A dog centred approach to the analysis of dogs' interactions with media on TV screens
works.description: A study of how dogs move their attention between three TV screens showing different videos, using a dog-centred method.
works.description_zh: 一项研究：用以狗为中心的方法，观察狗如何在播放不同视频的三块电视屏幕之间转移注意力。
works.idea_en: To know what dogs watch, let them choose among screens rather than forcing one.
works.idea_zh: 想知道狗在看什么，就让它在多块屏幕中自己选择，而不是只给一块。
works.method: Three-screen setup with video coding of each dog's gaze and position in a relatively uncontrolled environment.
works.method_zh: 三屏装置，在相对不受控的环境中对每只狗的注视和位置进行视频编码。

paper.title: A dog centred approach to the analysis of dogs' interactions with media on TV screens

works.title: DoggyVision: Examining how dogs (Canis familiaris) interact with media using a dog-driven proximity tracker device.
works.description: DoggyVision is a proximity device that lets a dog turn a TV on and off by approaching it, to study whether dogs would control their own viewing.
works.description_zh: DoggyVision 是一个接近感应装置，狗走近就能开关电视，用来研究狗是否会自己控制观看。
works.idea_en: A dog's approach can be the on switch.
works.idea_zh: 狗走过来，就是开机键。
works.method: Proximity tracker linked to a TV in home settings, logging activation and viewing time.
works.method_zh: 在家中把接近感应器与电视相连，记录开启次数和观看时长。

paper.title: DoggyVision: Examining how dogs (Canis familiaris) interact with media using a dog-driven proximity tracker device

works.title: On the Internet, Nobody Knows You're a Dog... Unless You're Another Dog
works.description: A design fiction on a dog internet: six co-designed proposals for devices through which dogs could connect with other dogs, not just with computers.
works.description_zh: 一个关于“狗互联网”的设计虚构：通过共同设计工作坊得出六个方案，让狗能与其他狗联系，而不仅仅是与计算机交互。
works.idea_en: ACI has built animal–computer interfaces; next is animal–animal communication through computers.
works.idea_zh: 动物-计算机交互已经造了动物与计算机的界面；下一步是经由计算机的动物与动物之间的沟通。
works.method: Co-design workshop producing narratives and concepts, analysed for what a dog internet should and should not be.
works.method_zh: 通过共同设计工作坊产出叙事和概念，并分析狗互联网应该和不应该是什么样子。

paper.title: On the Internet, Nobody Knows You're a Dog... Unless You're Another Dog

works.title: Call of the Wild Web: Comparing Parrot Engagement in Live vs. Pre-Recorded Video Calls
works.description: A six-month study in which pet parrots could trigger either live video calls with other parrots or recorded calls; they chose live calls much more.
works.description_zh: 一项为期六个月的研究：宠物鹦鹉可以触发与其他鹦鹉的实时视频通话或预录视频，结果它们明显更常选择实时通话。
works.idea_en: For social animals, a live connection is worth more than content.
works.idea_zh: 对群居动物来说，实时的联系比内容更有价值。
works.method: Parrot-operated tablet system logging triggers, engagement and behaviour for live vs pre-recorded calls.
works.method_zh: 由鹦鹉操作的平板系统，记录实时与预录通话的触发次数、投入程度和行为。

paper.title: Call of the Wild Web: Comparing Parrot Engagement in Live vs. Pre-Recorded Video Calls

works.title: Look What the Cat Tapped In: Exploring Digital Interactive Systems Designed for the Cat Cafe Experience
works.description: MewTube is a tablet app for cat cafés that plays curated videos for cats while visitors adjust playback speed to the cats' behaviour.
works.description_zh: MewTube 是一款用于猫咖啡馆的平板应用，为猫播放精选视频，并让游客根据猫的行为调整播放速度。
works.idea_en: Give visitors a way to play with cats that does not overload them.
works.idea_zh: 给游客一种不会让猫过度疲惫的玩法。
works.method: Five-month study with 28 people and 16 cats comparing conditions with and without the app.
works.method_zh: 为期五个月的研究，涉及 28 位游客和 16 只猫，对比有无应用两种情况。

paper.title: Look What the Cat Tapped In: Exploring Digital Interactive Systems Designed for the Cat Cafe Experience

works.title: Supporting interspecies social awareness: using peripheral displays for distributed pack awareness (PAWSABILITIES)
works.description: PAWSABILITIES is a set of peripheral displays that keep a family and their dog aware of each other's activities when apart.
works.description_zh: PAWSABILITIES 是一组外围显示装置，让家人和狗在分开时仍能感知彼此的活动。
works.idea_en: Remote awareness can include the dog as a member of the household.
works.idea_zh: 远程感知也可以把狗当作家庭成员包括进来。
works.method: Sensors and ambient displays for 'pack' activity shared between remote people and a dog at home.
works.method_zh: 传感器和环境显示把“狗群”活动在远方的人和家中的狗之间共享。

paper.title: Supporting interspecies social awareness: using peripheral displays for distributed pack awareness

works.title: Cat@Log: sensing device attachable to pet cats for supporting human-pet interaction
works.description: Cat@Log is a set of sensing devices worn by pet cats that recognise their behaviour and post it to Twitter.
works.description_zh: Cat@Log 是一组供宠物猫佩戴的感应设备，能识别猫的行为并发布到 Twitter 上。
works.idea_en: A cat's day becomes a social media feed the owner can follow.
works.idea_zh: 猫的一天变成了主人可以关注的社交媒体动态。
works.method: Accelerometer, camera and other sensors on a collar feed a classifier that posts high-level behaviours.
works.method_zh: 项圈上的加速度计、摄像头等传感器把数据送入分类器，生成高层次行为并发布。

paper.title: Cat@Log: sensing device attachable to pet cats for supporting human-pet interaction

works.title: Communication technology for human-dog interaction: exploration of dog owners' experiences and expectations
works.description: Studies of dog owners and hunters on how they use communication technology with their dogs and what they expect from future devices.
works.description_zh: 针对狗主人和猎人的研究，了解他们如何与狗一起使用通信技术，以及对未来设备的期待。
works.idea_en: Hunters and pet owners want different things from dog technology; design for the context.
works.idea_zh: 猎人和宠物主人对狗用技术的需求不同；要依情境来设计。
works.method: Interviews and surveys with two user groups about current devices and desired services.
works.method_zh: 对两类用户进行访谈和问卷，了解现有设备和期望的服务。

paper.title: Communication technology for human-dog interaction: exploration of dog owners' experiences and expectations

works.title: Exploring pet video chat: the remote awareness and interaction needs of families with dogs and cats
works.description: A survey of dog and cat owners on how they would like to monitor and interact with their pets over video when away from home.
works.description_zh: 一项对猫狗主人的调查，了解他们离家时希望如何通过视频看护宠物并与之互动。
works.idea_en: Families treat pets as members they want to call, not just watch.
works.idea_zh: 家庭把宠物当作想要“打电话”的成员，而不只是被监看的对象。
works.method: Online survey analysed for awareness and interaction needs, with design implications for pet video chat.
works.method_zh: 对在线问卷进行分析，归纳感知和互动需求，并提出宠物视频聊天的设计建议。

paper.title: Exploring pet video chat: the remote awareness and interaction needs of families with dogs and cats

works.title: Exploring interspecies sensemaking: dog tracking semiotics and multispecies ethnography
works.description: An ethnography of GPS dog tracking that shows how tracking reshapes relations between dogs and owners and proposes an interspecies semiotics.
works.description_zh: 一项关于 GPS 狗追踪的民族志研究，揭示追踪如何重塑狗与主人之间的关系，并提出一种跨物种符号学。
works.idea_en: Tracking devices change both the dog and the person; study the pair.
works.idea_zh: 追踪设备同时改变狗和人；要研究的是这一对关系。
works.method: Multispecies ethnography combining owners' accounts, animal researchers' views and observation of tracked dogs.
works.method_zh: 结合主人叙述、动物研究者观点和对被追踪狗的观察，进行多物种民族志研究。

paper.title: Exploring interspecies sensemaking: dog tracking semiotics and multispecies ethnography

works.title: UbiComp for animal welfare: envisioning smart environments for kenneled dogs
works.description: An ethnographic study at a dog rehoming centre that proposes a welfare-centred framework for smart kennel environments.
works.description_zh: 在狗狗再安置中心开展的民族志研究，提出以福利为中心的智能犬舍环境框架。
works.idea_en: Smart environments for animals should start from welfare, not from data collection.
works.idea_zh: 为动物设计的智能环境应当从福利出发，而不是从数据收集出发。
works.method: Four months of fieldwork with staff and dogs, leading to a framework joining monitoring, interaction and information management.
works.method_zh: 与员工和狗一起进行为期四个月的田野调查，得出一个把监测、互动和信息管理结合起来的框架。

paper.title: UbiComp for animal welfare: envisioning smart environments for kenneled dogs

works.title: Understanding the Interaction Between Animals and Wearables: The Wearer Experience of Cats
works.description: A field study of 13 cats wearing popular GPS trackers that looked for signs of discomfort and wearability problems.
works.description_zh: 一项实地研究：观察 13 只佩戴市售 GPS 追踪器的猫，寻找不适迹象和佩戴上的问题。
works.idea_en: 'Animal-friendly' wearables should be tested on the animal's experience, not the owner's.
works.idea_zh: “对动物友好”的可穿戴设备，要以动物的体验来检验，而不是以主人的体验。
works.method: Behavioural observation and coding of cats with and without trackers during a field study.
works.method_zh: 在实地研究中对佩戴和不佩戴追踪器的猫进行行为观察与编码。

paper.title: Understanding the Interaction Between Animals and Wearables: The Wearer Experience of Cats

works.title: Meow Meow Call: Prototype Design for Building Interactive Connection between Human and Deaf Cat
works.description: Meow Meow Call is a prototype for connecting with deaf cats through light and vibration instead of voice.
works.description_zh: Meow Meow Call 是一个用光和振动代替声音与失聪猫咪建立联系的原型。
works.idea_en: Design for animals with disabilities by switching the sense, as in accessible design for people.
works.idea_zh: 像为人做无障碍设计一样，为残障动物换一种感官通道。
works.method: A three-part prototype tested for two weeks with two deaf cats and their keepers.
works.method_zh: 一个由三部分组成的原型，与两只失聪猫及其主人进行了为期两周的测试。

paper.title: Meow Meow Call: Prototype Design for Building Interactive Connection between Human and Deaf Cat

works.title: MeowPlayLive: Enhancing Animal Live Streaming Experience Through Voice Message-Based Real-Time Viewer-Animal Interaction
works.description: MeowPlayLive lets live-stream viewers send voice messages that appear as moving objects on a cat's tablet; a message is heard only if the cat taps it.
works.description_zh: MeowPlayLive 让直播观众发送语音消息，这些消息在猫的平板上变成移动的物体；只有猫拍到时，消息才会被播放。
works.idea_en: Let the animal decide which viewer gets through.
works.idea_zh: 让动物来决定哪位观众的话被听见。
works.method: Live-streaming platform linked to a cat-facing tablet game, deployed in real streams.
works.method_zh: 直播平台与面向猫的平板游戏相连，在真实直播中部署测试。

paper.title: MeowPlayLive: Enhancing Animal Live Streaming Experience Through Voice Message-Based Real-Time Viewer-Animal Interaction

works.title: Quantified Canine: Inferring Dog Personality From Wearables
works.description: Patchkeeper, a chest-worn sensor, collected 1,300 hours of activity data from 12 dogs and inferred their personality traits.
works.description_zh: 胸前佩戴的传感器 Patchkeeper 从 12 只狗身上收集了 1300 小时的活动数据，并推断出它们的性格特征。
works.idea_en: Activity data can stand in for a costly personality test, for example to match shelter dogs.
works.idea_zh: 活动数据可以替代昂贵的性格测评，比如用于为收容所的狗匹配领养家庭。
works.method: Accelerometer and gyroscope data modelled against validated dog personality questionnaires.
works.method_zh: 用加速度计和陀螺仪数据，对照经过验证的狗性格问卷建立模型。

paper.title: Quantified Canine: Inferring Dog Personality From Wearables

works.title: Buddy's Wearable Is Not Your Buddy: Privacy Implications of Pet Wearables
works.description: An analysis of pet wearable privacy policies showing that they collect more data about owners than about pets.
works.description_zh: 一项对宠物可穿戴设备隐私政策的分析，发现这些设备收集的主人数据多于宠物数据。
works.idea_en: A pet tracker is also a tracker of the person holding the leash.
works.idea_zh: 宠物追踪器同时也在追踪牵着绳子的那个人。
works.method: Document analysis of privacy policies of commercial pet wearables.
works.method_zh: 对市售宠物可穿戴设备的隐私政策进行文本分析。

paper.title: Buddy's Wearable Is Not Your Buddy: Privacy Implications of Pet Wearables

works.title: Automated recognition of pain in cats
works.description: Compares two machine-learning approaches, landmark-based and deep learning, that recognise pain in photos of cats' faces.
works.description_zh: 比较两种机器学习方法（基于面部标志点和深度学习），用来识别猫面部照片中的疼痛。
works.idea_en: A camera can read pain on a cat's face that owners often miss.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头能读出主人常常忽略的猫脸上的疼痛。
works.method: Facial images of 29 cats before and after surgery analysed with geometric landmarks and with deep neural networks.
works.method_zh: 对 29 只猫手术前后的面部图像，分别用几何标志点和深度神经网络进行分析。

paper.title: Automated recognition of pain in cats

works.title: K9-Blyzer: Towards Video-Based Automatic Analysis of Canine Behavior
works.description: K9-Blyzer is a tool that automatically analyses videos of dogs to quantify their behaviour.
works.description_zh: K9-Blyzer 是一个自动分析狗视频、量化其行为的工具。
works.idea_en: Automated video analysis lets behaviour be measured without a human coder for every second.
works.idea_zh: 自动视频分析让行为测量不必再依靠人工逐秒编码。
works.method: Computer-vision tracking of dogs in video, producing movement-based behavioural measures.
works.method_zh: 用计算机视觉在视频中追踪狗，生成基于运动的行为指标。

paper.title: K9-Blyzer: Towards Video-Based Automatic Analysis of Canine Behavior

works.title: Animal Ludens: Building Intelligent Playful Environments for Animals
works.description: Proposes intelligent playful environments for animals: spaces that sense animals and adapt games to them, rather than single-device games.
works.description_zh: 提出面向动物的智能游戏环境：能够感知动物并为其调整游戏的空间，而不是单一设备上的游戏。
works.idea_en: Play is the most natural way into interaction design for animals.
works.idea_zh: 玩耍是进入动物交互设计最自然的入口。
works.method: Framework for playful, sensor-rich environments that adapt to the animals and people in them.
works.method_zh: 一个框架：由传感器驱动、能适应其中动物和人的游戏化环境。

paper.title: Animal Ludens: Building Intelligent Playful Environments for Animals

works.title: Developing a depth-based tracking system for interactive playful environments with animals
works.description: A depth-camera tracking system that detects where animals are and how they are posed so that playful environments can respond to them.
works.description_zh: 一个深度相机追踪系统，检测动物的位置和姿态，让游戏环境能对它们作出回应。
works.idea_en: Games for animals need to know where the animal is and what its body is doing.
works.idea_zh: 给动物玩的游戏需要知道动物在哪里、身体在做什么。
works.method: Microsoft Kinect depth data processed to detect cats and their postures in a play space.
works.method_zh: 处理 Microsoft Kinect 的深度数据，在游戏空间中检测猫及其姿态。

paper.title: Developing a depth-based tracking system for interactive playful environments with animals

works.title: Sound to your objects: a novel design approach to evaluate orangutans' interest in sound-based stimuli
works.description: A design for zoo orangutans in which handling tangible objects triggers sounds, to test their interest in controlling auditory stimuli.
works.description_zh: 为动物园红毛猩猩做的设计：摆弄实物就会触发声音，用来检验它们是否有兴趣控制听觉刺激。
works.idea_en: Give apes control over what they hear by making sound respond to objects.
works.idea_zh: 让声音随物体而响，就把“听什么”的控制权交给了猿。
works.method: Tangible, non-digital-looking objects linked to sound playback, planned with Melbourne Zoo orangutans.
works.method_zh: 外观不像电子产品的实物与声音播放相连，与墨尔本动物园的红毛猩猩一起规划。

paper.title: Sound to your objects: a novel design approach to evaluate orangutans' interest in sound-based stimuli

works.title: Designing interspecies playful interactions: studying children perceptions of games with animals
works.description: Children designed games to be played between humans and animals, with and without technology, to show how they imagine interspecies play.
works.description_zh: 让孩子们设计人与动物之间的游戏（有的用技术，有的不用），以了解他们如何想象跨物种玩耍。
works.idea_en: Children are natural co-designers for games with animals.
works.idea_zh: 孩子是设计人与动物游戏的天然合作者。
works.method: Design sessions with children analysed for game mechanics, roles and attitudes to the animals.
works.method_zh: 分析儿童设计活动中的游戏机制、角色分配和对动物的态度。

paper.title: Designing interspecies playful interactions: studying children perceptions of games with animals

works.title: Purrfect Crime: Exploring Animal Computer Interaction through a Digital Game for Humans and Cats
works.description: Purrfect Crime is a tablet game in which a person and a cat play together with different roles on the same screen.
works.description_zh: Purrfect Crime 是一款平板游戏，人和猫在同一块屏幕上以不同角色一起玩。
works.idea_en: Asymmetric roles let two species share one game.
works.idea_zh: 不对称的角色让两个物种能共享同一款游戏。
works.method: Tablet game where the cat chases moving targets while the human plays a strategic role; tested with cats and people.
works.method_zh: 猫在平板上追逐移动目标，人承担策略性角色；与猫和人一起进行了测试。

paper.title: Purrfect Crime: Exploring Animal Computer Interaction through a Digital Game for Humans and Cats

works.title: Designing Mediated Nurturing Play with Dogs to Alleviate Workplace Stress
works.description: A system that connects office workers with rescued dogs at a distance for short nurturing play sessions, aimed at both workplace stress and dog wellbeing.
works.description_zh: 一个系统：让办公室员工与远方的救助犬进行简短的养育式玩耍，同时缓解职场压力、增进狗的福祉。
works.idea_en: Remote play can bring the benefits of animal-assisted activity into places animals cannot go.
works.idea_zh: 远程玩耍可以把动物辅助活动的益处带到动物进不去的地方。
works.method: Human–computer–animal play system linking a worker's actions to toys and treats for remote shelter dogs.
works.method_zh: 人-计算机-动物的游戏系统，把员工的操作连接到远方收容所狗的玩具和零食上。

paper.title: Designing Mediated Nurturing Play with Dogs to Alleviate Workplace Stress

works.title: Exploring the Reactions of Companion Animals as Unintended Users of Social Robots
works.description: An exploratory study of how two house cats reacted to a small social robot placed in their home, comparing sudden and gradual introduction.
works.description_zh: 一项探索性研究：观察两只家猫对放在家中的小型社交机器人的反应，比较突然引入和逐步引入两种方式。
works.idea_en: Pets are unintended users of home robots; introduce robots in a way that respects their senses.
works.idea_zh: 宠物是家用机器人的“非预期用户”；引入机器人时要顾及它们的感官。
works.method: Informal design research with observation of cat behaviour around a social robot under two introduction strategies.
works.method_zh: 非正式的设计研究：在两种引入策略下观察猫在社交机器人周围的行为。

paper.title: Exploring the Reactions of Companion Animals as Unintended Users of Social Robots

works.title: Dog Driven Robot: Towards Quantifying Problem-Solving Abilities in Dogs
works.description: Dogs remotely drove a small robot through a maze by pulling, pressing or approaching an input device, as a test of problem-solving ability.
works.description_zh: 狗通过拉、按或靠近输入装置，远程驾驶一台小机器人穿过迷宫，用来测试它们的解决问题能力。
works.idea_en: Let a dog steer a robot and you can measure how it solves problems.
works.idea_zh: 让狗驾驶机器人，就能测量它如何解决问题。
works.method: Three affordances (tug, button, proximity) on a raised platform trigger robot movement with visual feedback.
works.method_zh: 高台上的三种输入方式（拉绳、按钮、接近）触发机器人移动，并提供视觉反馈。

paper.title: Dog Driven Robot: Towards Quantifying Problem-Solving Abilities in Dogs

works.title: Umamimi robotic horse ears: using configurable code profiles to replicate individuality in equine animatronics
works.description: Umamimi are programmable robotic horse ears that a person can wear to 'talk' to horses with ear signals, or that can act as a companion for a solitary horse.
works.description_zh: Umamimi 是可编程的机器马耳：人可以戴上它用耳朵信号与马“交谈”，它也可以作为独处马匹的陪伴。
works.idea_en: Borrow the animal's own body language as the interface.
works.idea_zh: 借用动物自己的肢体语言作为界面。
works.method: Servo-driven animatronic ears with configurable code profiles for user-triggered and random movements.
works.method_zh: 舵机驱动的仿生马耳，可配置代码参数，实现用户触发和随机两种动作。

paper.title: Umamimi robotic horse ears: using configurable code profiles to replicate individuality in equine animatronics

works.title: Dog-drone interactions: towards an ACI perspective
works.description: A short note calling for an animal-centred approach to how dogs encounter drones, so that the interactions are safe and not stressful.
works.description_zh: 一篇短文，呼吁用以动物为中心的方式看待狗与无人机的相遇，让这种互动安全且不造成压力。
works.idea_en: Drones will meet dogs; design that meeting from the dog's side.
works.idea_zh: 无人机终会遇到狗；要从狗的一侧来设计这次相遇。
works.method: Position paper with observations of dog responses to drones.
works.method_zh: 结合对狗面对无人机时反应的观察写成的立场论文。

paper.title: Dog-drone interactions: towards an ACI perspective

works.title: Exploring human perceptions of dog-tablet playful interactions
works.description: An exploratory study of how people perceive dogs playing with tablets, and whether they see it as real play.
works.description_zh: 一项探索性研究：人们如何看待狗玩平板电脑，是否认为那是真正的玩耍。
works.idea_en: Whether a dog is 'playing' a tablet game depends on who is watching and how.
works.idea_zh: 狗是否在“玩”平板游戏，取决于谁在看、怎么看。
works.method: Online study showing videos of dog–tablet interaction and collecting people's interpretations.
works.method_zh: 在线研究：展示狗与平板互动的视频，收集人们的解读。

paper.title: Exploring human perceptions of dog-tablet playful interactions

works.title: Towards a canine-human communication system based on head gestures
