works.description: A system in which a dog sends messages to a person with trained head gestures, sensed by a collar-worn motion sensor.
works.description_zh: 一个系统：狗用经过训练的头部动作向人发送信息，由项圈上的运动传感器感知。
works.idea_en: A dog's head movements can be a vocabulary if the device can read them reliably.
works.idea_zh: 只要设备能可靠读取，狗的头部动作就可以成为一套词汇。
works.method: Inertial sensing on the collar and gesture detection evaluated against minimum criteria for a canine gesture set.
works.method_zh: 项圈上的惯性传感与手势识别，依据狗手势集的最低标准进行评估。

paper.title: Towards a canine-human communication system based on head gestures

works.title: Training collar-sensed gestures for canine communication
works.description: Two dogs were trained to perform precise gestures that a collar sensor detects and relays to a handler's phone, for example 'wait' versus 'go around'.
works.description_zh: 训练两只狗做出精确的动作，由项圈传感器检测并发送到训导员手机上，例如区分“等一等”和“绕过去”。
works.idea_en: Training and sensing must be designed together for a dog to 'speak' through a device.
works.idea_zh: 要让狗通过设备“说话”，训练和传感必须一起设计。
works.method: IMU on a collar, gesture classifier and companion smartphone app; training protocol described step by step.
works.method_zh: 项圈上的惯性测量单元、手势分类器和配套手机应用，并逐步说明训练流程。

paper.title: Training collar-sensed gestures for canine communication

works.title: Towards the non-visual monitoring of canine physiology in real-time by blind handlers
works.description: A wearable system that lets visually impaired guide dog handlers monitor their dog's physiology in real time through non-visual feedback.
works.description_zh: 一套可穿戴系统，让视障的导盲犬使用者通过非视觉反馈实时了解狗的生理状态。
works.idea_en: Canine body signals can reach a handler who cannot see them, through sound or touch.
works.idea_zh: 狗的身体信号可以通过声音或触觉，传达给看不见它们的使用者。
works.method: Wireless harness with heart rate and other sensors, relayed as audio or haptic feedback.
works.method_zh: 装有心率等传感器的无线背带，把数据转为声音或触觉反馈。

paper.title: Towards the non-visual monitoring of canine physiology in real-time by blind handlers

works.title: Search and rescue: dog and handler collaboration through wearable and mobile interfaces
works.description: A wearable interface for search-and-rescue dogs that sends information to the handler's mobile app, with a framework that treats dogs as active participants.
works.description_zh: 一套供搜救犬佩戴的界面，把信息发送到训导员的手机应用，并提出把狗当作主动参与者的框架。
works.idea_en: The dog finds the person; the vest tells the handler what the dog found.
works.idea_zh: 狗找到人，背心告诉训导员狗找到了什么。
works.method: Dog-activated wearable (bite or tug sensors) linked to a mobile app, developed with heuristics from SAR handlers.
works.method_zh: 由狗触发的可穿戴设备（咬合或拉扯传感器）与手机应用相连，依据搜救训导员的经验法则开发。

paper.title: Search and rescue: dog and handler collaboration through wearable and mobile interfaces

works.title: The impact of training approaches on experimental setup and design of wearable vibrotactiles for hunting dogs
works.description: The VibroTactile Vest gives commands to hunting dogs through vibrating motors, and the study shows how training methods shape the design.
works.description_zh: VibroTactile Vest 通过振动马达向猎犬发出指令，研究展示了训练方法如何影响设计。
works.idea_en: How an animal is trained decides what an interface for it must be.
works.idea_zh: 动物如何被训练，决定了为它设计的界面必须是什么样子。
works.method: Variable-intensity vibration motors mounted in a modified shirt, tested with dogs trained by different approaches.
works.method_zh: 把可调强度的振动马达装在改造过的背心里，与接受不同训练方法的狗一起测试。

paper.title: The impact of training approaches on experimental setup and design of wearable vibrotactiles for hunting dogs

works.title: Dogs Can Understand Haptic Communication
works.description: A vest with vibration motors was used to train a dog to tell apart four vibration patterns and follow the matching commands.
works.description_zh: 用装有振动马达的背心训练一只狗分辨四种振动模式，并执行对应的指令。
works.idea_en: Touch can carry commands where voice and gesture fail, such as in noise or at a distance.
works.idea_zh: 在嘈杂或远距离、声音和手势失效的地方，触觉可以传递指令。
works.method: Vibration patterns differing in location and timing, taught by operant conditioning.
works.method_zh: 位置和时间不同的振动模式，通过操作性条件反射教给狗。

paper.title: Dogs Can Understand Haptic Communication

works.title: Designing an emergency communication system for human and assistance dog partnerships
works.description: An alarm system that assistance dogs can activate to call for help for their owners, co-designed with dogs and owners throughout.
works.description_zh: 一套辅助犬可以启动、为主人呼救的警报系统，全程与狗和主人一起共同设计。
works.idea_en: The dog is an end user of the alarm, so involve it in every design step.
works.idea_zh: 狗是这套警报的终端用户，所以每一步设计都要让它参与。
works.method: High-fidelity canine-operated alarm prototype, tested for the level of support dogs need across emergency types.
works.method_zh: 高保真的狗操作警报原型，测试狗在不同紧急情况下需要多少支持。

paper.title: Designing an emergency communication system for human and assistance dog partnerships

works.title: Tricks and Treats: Designing Technology to Support Mobility Assistance Dogs
works.description: An accessible treat dispenser that lets people with tetraplegia reward and train their mobility assistance dogs themselves.
works.description_zh: 一个无障碍零食机，让四肢瘫痪者能自己奖励和训练他们的行动辅助犬。
works.idea_en: Support the relationship between person and dog, not replace the dog's labour with technology.
works.idea_zh: 去支持人与狗之间的关系，而不是用技术取代狗的劳动。
works.method: Interviews with owners and a case study of an accessible, remotely triggered treat dispenser.
works.method_zh: 对主人的访谈，以及一个可远程触发的无障碍零食机的案例研究。

paper.title: Tricks and Treats: Designing Technology to Support Mobility Assistance Dogs

works.title: Canine Co-design: Investigating Buttons as an Input Modality for Dogs
works.description: A two-phase study with dogs on how button size, force and placement affect how they press, as input for canine interfaces.
works.description_zh: 一项分两阶段的研究：与狗一起测试按钮大小、所需力度和位置如何影响它们按压，为狗用界面提供依据。
works.idea_en: Before building a dog interface, co-design its buttons with dogs.
works.idea_zh: 在做狗用界面之前，先和狗一起设计按钮。
works.method: Prototype buttons of different properties tested with dogs; pressing behaviour recorded and analysed.
works.method_zh: 用不同属性的按钮原型与狗一起测试，记录并分析按压行为。

paper.title: Canine Co-design: Investigating Buttons as an Input Modality for Dogs

works.title: Understanding people and animals: the use of a positioning system in ordinary human-canine interaction
works.description: An ethnographic study of how hunters use a GPS dog-tracking device and how it changes the interaction between hunters and dogs.
works.description_zh: 一项民族志研究：猎人如何使用 GPS 狗追踪设备，以及它如何改变猎人与狗之间的互动。
works.idea_en: Study what people and dogs do together with a device, not what the device claims to show.
works.idea_zh: 研究人和狗借助设备一起做了什么，而不是设备声称显示了什么。
works.method: Video-based fieldwork on moose hunts analysed with an ethnomethodological view of anthropomorphism.
works.method_zh: 对驼鹿狩猎进行视频田野调查，并从常人方法学的角度分析拟人化。

paper.title: Understanding people and animals: the use of a positioning system in ordinary human-canine interaction

works.title: Understanding guide dog team interactions: design opportunities to support work and play
works.description: A study of guide dog teams' everyday work and leisure that identifies design opportunities for both.
works.description_zh: 一项关于导盲犬团队日常工作与闲暇的研究，并为两者找出设计机会。
works.idea_en: Design for the play of a working team, not only its work.
works.idea_zh: 为一个工作团队的玩耍而设计，而不只是为它的工作。
works.method: Interviews and observations with guide dog handlers across work and leisure activities.
works.method_zh: 在工作和闲暇活动中对导盲犬使用者进行访谈和观察。

paper.title: Understanding guide dog team interactions: design opportunities to support work and play

works.title: Mobile Collaboration for Human and Canine Police Explosive Detection Teams
works.description: A mobile communication system for multi-agency police explosive-detection searches carried out by officers and their dogs.
works.description_zh: 为多个机构联合开展的警察与警犬爆炸物搜查设计的移动通信系统。
works.idea_en: Design for the whole human–dog team and the agencies around it.
works.idea_zh: 要为整个人犬团队以及周围的各个机构而设计。
works.method: Fieldwork with detection teams and a mobile app that shares search areas and dog alerts.
works.method_zh: 与搜查队开展田野调查，开发共享搜索区域和警犬报警信息的手机应用。

paper.title: Mobile Collaboration for Human and Canine Police Explosive Detection Teams

works.title: Predicting the Suitability of Service Animals Using Instrumented Dog Toys
works.description: Instrumented dog toys recorded how young service-dog candidates bite and tug; the data predicted which dogs would succeed in advanced training.
works.description_zh: 带传感器的狗玩具记录了服务犬候选幼犬的咬合与拉扯方式，这些数据能预测哪些狗能通过高级训练。
works.idea_en: Play objects can measure temperament and save years of training on unsuitable dogs.
works.idea_zh: 玩具可以测量性格，从而免去在不合适的狗身上花费数年训练。
works.method: Pressure and motion sensors in toys, used over a two-year longitudinal study; classifiers predict placement success.
works.method_zh: 在玩具中装入压力和运动传感器，进行为期两年的追踪研究，用分类器预测是否能成功安置。

paper.title: Predicting the Suitability of Service Animals Using Instrumented Dog Toys

works.title: From Ideation to Deployment: A Narrative Case Study of Citizen Science Supported Wearables for Raising Guide Dogs
works.description: A case study of scaling a wearable sensor system for guide dog puppies from a lab prototype to deployment with volunteer puppy raisers.
works.description_zh: 一个案例研究：把导盲犬幼犬用的可穿戴传感系统从实验室原型推广到志愿寄养家庭中使用。
works.idea_en: Scaling an animal wearable means designing for the volunteers who put it on the dog.
works.idea_zh: 推广一款动物可穿戴设备，也意味着要为给狗穿戴它的志愿者而设计。
works.method: Smart harness and app developed with guide dog schools and deployed through citizen science.
works.method_zh: 与导盲犬学校一起开发智能背带和应用，并通过公民科学方式部署。

paper.title: From Ideation to Deployment: A Narrative Case Study of Citizen Science Supported Wearables for Raising Guide Dogs

works.title: WAG’D: Towards a Wearable Activity and Gait Detection Monitor for Sled Dogs
works.description: WAG'D is a wearable that measures pull force and gait in sled dogs to spot injuries during training and races.
works.description_zh: WAG'D 是一款测量雪橇犬拉力和步态的可穿戴设备，用来在训练和比赛中发现伤病。
works.idea_en: Instrument the harness to catch injuries mushers cannot see.
works.idea_zh: 在挽具里加装传感器，发现驾驶者看不到的伤病。
works.method: Load and inertial sensors in the harness with data logging, designed with Iditarod mushers and vets.
works.method_zh: 在挽具中装入拉力和惯性传感器并记录数据，与艾迪塔罗德雪橇赛的驾驶者和兽医一起设计。

paper.title: WAG’D: Towards a Wearable Activity and Gait Detection Monitor for Sled Dogs

works.title: Wearable Sensors for Canine Nosework Sniffing Interaction
works.description: A dog wearable with a microphone and motion sensors that classifies sniffing and search behaviour in nosework dogs.
works.description_zh: 一款装有麦克风和运动传感器的狗用可穿戴设备，用来识别嗅探犬的嗅闻和搜索行为。
works.idea_en: Hear the sniff: audio can reveal what a detection dog is doing.
works.idea_zh: 听见嗅闻声：声音能透露检测犬正在做什么。
works.method: Cardioid microphone and two IMUs feed machine-learning classifiers of nosework behaviours.
works.method_zh: 心形指向麦克风和两个惯性测量单元的数据送入机器学习分类器，识别嗅探行为。

paper.title: Wearable Sensors for Canine Nosework Sniffing Interaction

works.title: Towards Enactivist ACI - Sensor-Rich Olfactory Workstation and Suit for Detection Dogs
works.description: A sensor-rich sniffing workstation and wearable suit for cancer-detection dogs that captures how a dog's actions and senses are coupled during scent tasks.
works.description_zh: 为癌症检测犬设计的多传感器嗅闻工作台和穿戴服，记录狗在气味任务中动作与感官的耦合。
works.idea_en: Treat the dog's sniffing as an active, embodied process and record all of it.
works.idea_zh: 把狗的嗅闻看作一种主动的、具身的过程，并完整记录下来。
works.method: Infrared sensors, IMUs and other streams synchronised around sample ports, grounded in enactive cognition.
works.method_zh: 红外传感器、惯性测量单元等数据流围绕样本口同步采集，以生成认知理论为基础。

paper.title: Towards Enactivist ACI - Sensor-Rich Olfactory Workstation and Suit for Detection Dogs

works.title: Towards Robotic Companions: Understanding Handler-Guide Dog Interactions for Informed Guide Dog Robot Design
works.description: Interviews with guide dog handlers and trainers on how handlers and dogs work together, to inform the design of legged guide dog robots.
works.description_zh: 访谈导盲犬使用者和训练师，了解人与狗如何配合，为四足导盲机器人的设计提供依据。
works.idea_en: Before building a robot dog guide, learn what a real dog guide team does.
works.idea_zh: 在制造导盲机器狗之前，先搞清楚真实的导盲犬团队是怎么工作的。
works.method: Qualitative study of handler–guide dog interaction, translated into robot design requirements.
works.method_zh: 对使用者与导盲犬互动的质性研究，并转化为机器人设计需求。

paper.title: Towards Robotic Companions: Understanding Handler-Guide Dog Interactions for Informed Guide Dog Robot Design

works.title: Designing for intuitive use for non-human users
works.description: Argues, from touchscreen games made for orangutans, that tangible interfaces and familiar actions can make digital technology intuitive for animals.
works.description_zh: 基于为红毛猩猩制作的触屏游戏，论文主张可触摸的界面和动物熟悉的动作能让数字技术对动物来说更直观。
works.idea_en: Intuitive use for animals comes from what their bodies already know.
works.idea_zh: 对动物来说的“直观”，来自它们身体已经熟悉的东西。
works.method: Reflection on orangutan game design, drawing on knowledge transfer from domains familiar to the animal.
works.method_zh: 反思红毛猩猩游戏设计，借鉴从动物熟悉领域迁移知识的思路。

paper.title: Designing for intuitive use for non-human users

works.title: Naturalism and ACI: augmenting zoo enclosures with digital technology
works.description: Discusses how zoos value naturalistic enclosures and what this means for putting digital technology into them, based on interviews with zoo staff.
works.description_zh: 基于对动物园员工的访谈，讨论动物园如何重视自然化展区，以及这对在展区中引入数字技术意味着什么。
works.idea_en: Digital enrichment in zoos has to fit an ideal of naturalism; hide the tech, keep the behaviour natural.
works.idea_zh: 动物园里的数字丰容要符合自然主义理想：把技术藏起来，让行为保持自然。
works.method: Literature review and interviews with Zoos Victoria staff within a digital enrichment project.
works.method_zh: 在一个数字丰容项目中进行文献综述，并访谈维多利亚动物园的员工。

paper.title: Naturalism and ACI: augmenting zoo enclosures with digital technology

works.title: Don't cut to the chase: hunting experiences for zoo animals and visitors
works.description: A workshop exploring technology that supports hunting behaviour in zoo animals while giving visitors a parallel game experience.
works.description_zh: 一次工作坊，探讨如何用技术支持动物园动物的狩猎行为，同时为游客提供一个平行的游戏体验。
works.idea_en: Link an animal's hunting enrichment to a visitor game and both sides gain.
works.idea_zh: 把动物的狩猎丰容和游客的游戏连在一起，双方都会受益。
works.method: Workshop format with zoo briefs on predator enrichment and visitor engagement.
works.method_zh: 围绕捕食动物丰容和游客参与，以动物园需求为题开展工作坊。

paper.title: Don't cut to the chase: hunting experiences for zoo animals and visitors

works.title: Sonic Experiments with Grey Parrots: A Report on Testing the Auditory Skills and Musical Preferences of Grey Parrots in Captivity
works.description: Experiments testing the hearing and musical preferences of captive grey parrots, as groundwork for sonic enrichment.
works.description_zh: 测试圈养非洲灰鹦鹉听觉能力和音乐偏好的实验，为声音丰容打基础。
works.idea_en: Find out what a parrot hears and likes before building it an instrument.
works.idea_zh: 在为鹦鹉造乐器之前，先弄清它听到什么、喜欢什么。
works.method: Playback and interactive sound experiments with a group of grey parrots at a rescue facility.
works.method_zh: 在救助机构中对一群非洲灰鹦鹉进行播放和互动式声音实验。

paper.title: Sonic Experiments with Grey Parrots: A Report on Testing the Auditory Skills and Musical Preferences of Grey Parrots in Captivity

works.title: Animal-Centred Sonic Interaction Design: Musical Instruments and Interfaces for Grey Parrots
works.description: Musical instruments and interfaces designed around grey parrots' bodies, hearing and curiosity, tested as auditory enrichment.
works.description_zh: 围绕非洲灰鹦鹉的身体、听觉和好奇心设计的乐器与界面，作为听觉丰容进行测试。
works.idea_en: Design the instrument for the beak and the ear of the player.
works.idea_zh: 为演奏者的喙和耳朵来设计乐器。
works.method: Iterative prototypes of tangible sound instruments evaluated with a parrot group, following an animal-centred process.
works.method_zh: 按以动物为中心的流程迭代制作可触摸的发声乐器，并与鹦鹉群一起评估。

paper.title: Animal-Centred Sonic Interaction Design: Musical Instruments and Interfaces for Grey Parrots

works.title: Gorilla game lab: exploring modularity, tangibility and playful engagement in cognitive enrichment design
works.description: Gorilla Game Lab designed and tested modular, tangible puzzle devices with seven western lowland gorillas at Bristol Zoo.
works.description_zh: Gorilla Game Lab 与布里斯托动物园的七只西部低地大猩猩一起，设计并测试了模块化、可触摸的谜题装置。
works.idea_en: Modular puzzles let keepers change the challenge so enrichment stays interesting.
works.idea_zh: 模块化谜题让饲养员可以随时改变难度，让丰容保持吸引力。
works.method: Modular hardware puzzles with embedded sensing to log use, evaluated with the gorilla troop.
works.method_zh: 内嵌传感器记录使用情况的模块化硬件谜题，与大猩猩群一起评估。

paper.title: Gorilla game lab: exploring modularity, tangibility and playful engagement in cognitive enrichment design

works.title: Computer tasks for great apes promote functional naturalism in a zoo setting
works.description: Argues that touchscreen tasks for apes in zoos offer 'functional naturalism', mental challenges similar to those wild apes face.
works.description_zh: 论文主张：动物园里给猿类的触屏任务提供了“功能性自然主义”，即与野生猿类所面临的相似的心智挑战。
works.idea_en: A screen task can be natural if the thinking it demands is natural.
works.idea_zh: 只要所要求的思考是自然的，屏幕任务也可以是自然的。
works.method: Review of automated methods in ape research and their use at Indianapolis Zoo.
works.method_zh: 回顾猿类研究中的自动化方法，以及它们在印第安纳波利斯动物园的应用。

paper.title: Computer tasks for great apes promote functional naturalism in a zoo setting

works.title: The Arena System: a novel shared touch-panel apparatus for the study of chimpanzee social interaction and cognition
works.description: The Arena System is a shared touch-panel apparatus in which two chimpanzees work side by side, used to study their social interaction and cognition.
works.description_zh: Arena System 是一套共享触控装置，两只黑猩猩可以并排操作，用于研究它们的社会互动与认知。
works.idea_en: A shared screen turns individual cognitive tests into social ones.
works.idea_zh: 一块共享屏幕把个体认知测试变成了社会性测试。
works.method: Two linked touch-panels with feeders and a master PC, controlled by custom software at the Primate Research Institute, Kyoto University.
works.method_zh: 两个互联的触控面板配有喂食器和主控电脑，在京都大学灵长类研究所由定制软件控制。

paper.title: The Arena System: a novel shared touch-panel apparatus for the study of chimpanzee social interaction and cognition

works.title: Apex and ApeTouch: Development of a Portable Touchscreen System and Software for Primates at Zoos
works.description: Apex is a portable touchscreen system and ApeTouch its software, built so that zoos can offer primates touchscreen tasks without custom engineering.
works.description_zh: Apex 是一套便携式触摸屏系统，ApeTouch 是配套软件，让动物园无需自己开发就能为灵长类提供触屏任务。
works.idea_en: Lower the barrier and more zoos will offer cognitive enrichment.
works.idea_zh: 降低门槛，就会有更多动物园提供认知丰容。
works.method: Weatherproof touchscreen unit with a reward dispenser, running open task software, deployed with apes at zoos.
works.method_zh: 带奖励投放器的防水触屏单元运行开放的任务软件，在动物园中与猿类一起使用。

paper.title: Apex and ApeTouch: Development of a Portable Touchscreen System and Software for Primates at Zoos

works.title: Interactive technology and human–animal encounters at the zoo
works.description: A study of interactive systems at Melbourne Zoo that shows how technology shapes encounters between visitors, keepers and animals.
works.description_zh: 一项关于墨尔本动物园互动系统的研究，展示技术如何塑造游客、饲养员与动物之间的相遇。
works.idea_en: Zoo technology always serves several species at once; design for all of them.
works.idea_zh: 动物园里的技术总是同时服务于多个物种；要为它们全部而设计。
works.method: Observation and interviews around digital installations at the zoo.
works.method_zh: 围绕动物园中的数字装置进行观察和访谈。

paper.title: Interactive technology and human–animal encounters at the zoo

works.title: Co-Designing with Orangutans: Enhancing the Design of Enrichment for Animals
works.description: The design journey of an interactive projection installation for orangutans at Melbourne Zoo, in which the orangutans' responses steered each iteration.
works.description_zh: 为墨尔本动物园红毛猩猩设计互动投影装置的全过程，每一轮迭代都由红毛猩猩的反应来引导。
works.idea_en: Animals can be generative co-designers when their responses decide the next prototype.
works.idea_zh: 当动物的反应决定下一个原型时，它们就是有创造力的共同设计者。
works.method: Iterative co-design with orangutans, keepers and designers using projections and Kinect sensing.
works.method_zh: 与红毛猩猩、饲养员和设计师一起迭代共同设计，使用投影和 Kinect 感应。

paper.title: Co-Designing with Orangutans: Enhancing the Design of Enrichment for Animals

works.title: Interspecies Interactions Mediated by Technology: An Avian Case Study at the Zoo
works.description: Two interactive sound systems at the San Diego Zoo let Sampson, a hyacinth macaw, choose and control music in his enclosure.
works.description_zh: 圣迭戈动物园的两套互动声音系统，让一只名叫 Sampson 的紫蓝金刚鹦鹉在自己的笼舍里选择并控制音乐。
works.idea_en: Give a zoo animal control over its soundscape, not just a recording to hear.
works.idea_zh: 给动物园动物对声音环境的控制权，而不只是播放一段录音给它听。
works.method: Perch- and touch-based interfaces triggering audio, deployed and observed with the macaw and keepers.
works.method_zh: 基于栖木和触碰的界面触发音频，与鹦鹉和饲养员一起部署并观察。

paper.title: Interspecies Interactions Mediated by Technology: An Avian Case Study at the Zoo

works.title: Soundyssey: Hybrid Enrichment System for Elephants in Managed Care
works.description: Soundyssey is an enrichment system for two elephants at the San Diego Zoo that lets them trigger sounds and gives them choice and control.
works.description_zh: Soundyssey 是为圣迭戈动物园两头大象设计的丰容系统，让它们自己触发声音，获得选择权和控制权。
works.idea_en: Enrichment works better when the animal decides when it happens.
works.idea_zh: 当动物自己决定何时发生时，丰容的效果更好。
works.method: Hybrid physical–digital device with trunk-accessible triggers and audio output, deployed at the zoo.
works.method_zh: 物理与数字结合的装置，象鼻可触及的触发器连接音频输出，在动物园中部署。

paper.title: Soundyssey: Hybrid Enrichment System for Elephants in Managed Care

works.title: Platypus Surfing: In Search of the Perfect Wave
works.description: A wave machine that Sam, a platypus at Melbourne Zoo, can switch on by swimming near a sensor, giving him choice over when waves run.
works.description_zh: 一台造浪装置：墨尔本动物园的鸭嘴兽 Sam 游到传感器附近就能启动，让它自己选择何时有浪。
works.idea_en: Even a platypus can be given a switch.
works.idea_zh: 就连鸭嘴兽，也可以拥有一个开关。
works.method: Underwater proximity sensor triggering programmed wave sequences, developed with keepers and welfare specialists.
works.method_zh: 水下接近传感器触发预设的造浪序列，与饲养员和福利专家一起开发。

paper.title: Platypus Surfing: In Search of the Perfect Wave

works.title: Digital Enrichment with Captive Siamang: Video Showcase of Primate Preference
works.description: Two captive siamangs were given tablet computers in a permanent technology area and filmed to document what they chose to use.
works.description_zh: 为两只圈养合趾猿在固定的技术区域提供平板电脑，并拍摄记录它们选择使用什么。
works.idea_en: Give small apes their own tech corner and let preference show itself.
works.idea_zh: 给小型猿类一个自己的技术角落，让偏好自然显露出来。
works.method: Tablets with apps in a protected station, video recording of voluntary use.
works.method_zh: 把装有应用的平板放在受保护的操作台上，录像记录自愿使用情况。

paper.title: Digital Enrichment with Captive Siamang: Video Showcase of Primate Preference

works.title: Co-designing Enrichment Toys with Bottlenose Dolphins: Playfulness as a Corrective to Anthropocentrism
works.description: Enrichment toys co-designed in playful collaboration with bottlenose dolphins at a marine park in Malta, with reflection on moments of interspecies friction.
works.description_zh: 与马耳他一家海洋公园的宽吻海豚以游戏方式合作，共同设计丰容玩具，并反思跨物种摩擦的时刻。
works.idea_en: Play with the animal while designing and it will push back on your assumptions.
works.idea_zh: 设计时与动物一起玩，它会反驳你的假设。
works.method: Iterative toy prototypes tested in play sessions with dolphins and trainers at Mediterraneo Marine Park.
works.method_zh: 在 Mediterraneo 海洋公园与海豚和训练员一起进行游戏式测试，迭代玩具原型。

paper.title: Co-designing Enrichment Toys with Bottlenose Dolphins: Playfulness as a Corrective to Anthropocentrism

works.title: Play That Trunky Music: Development of an Auditory Enrichment Device for Elephants in Zoos
works.description: An audio enrichment system added to the feeding wall of African elephants at Zoo Atlanta, playing sounds when elephants reach into its holes.
works.description_zh: 为亚特兰大动物园非洲象的觅食墙加装的音频丰容系统，大象把鼻子伸进孔洞时就会播放声音。
works.idea_en: Add a new sense to existing enrichment instead of building from scratch.
works.idea_zh: 在已有的丰容设施上加入新的感官，而不是从零开始。
works.method: Sensors in the trunk holes trigger audio; usage logged and compared with food-only enrichment.
works.method_zh: 孔洞中的传感器触发音频，记录使用情况并与只有食物的丰容对比。

paper.title: Play That Trunky Music: Development of an Auditory Enrichment Device for Elephants in Zoos

works.title: Shelling Out the Fun: Quantifying Otter Interactions with Instrumented Enrichment Objects
works.description: Sensors hidden inside enrichment toys measure how individual sea otters at Georgia Aquarium play with them over time.
works.description_zh: 藏在丰容玩具里的传感器，长期测量佐治亚水族馆里每只海獭如何玩耍。
works.idea_en: Instrument the toy, not the animal.
works.idea_zh: 把传感器装进玩具，而不是装在动物身上。
works.method: Waterproof sensor packages in enrichment objects transmit motion data wirelessly to a base station.
works.method_zh: 防水传感模块装入丰容物件，把运动数据无线传到基站。

paper.title: Shelling Out the Fun: Quantifying Otter Interactions with Instrumented Enrichment Objects

works.title: Prototyping with Monkeys: Uncovering What Buttons for Monkeys Look Like
works.description: Rapid prototyping with zoo monkeys to find out what physical buttons for monkeys should look like; they preferred pulling and swinging over pushing.
works.description_zh: 与动物园猴子一起快速制作原型，探索猴子用的实体按钮应是什么样子；结果它们更喜欢拉和摇，而不是按。
works.idea_en: A 'button' for a monkey may be a rope, not a push switch.
works.idea_zh: 对猴子来说，“按钮”也许是一根绳子，而不是按压开关。
works.method: Series of low-fidelity tangible input prototypes tested with white-faced sakis, varying colour and interaction type.
works.method_zh: 与白脸僧面猴一起测试一系列低保真实体输入原型，改变颜色和交互方式。

paper.title: Prototyping with Monkeys: Uncovering What Buttons for Monkeys Look Like

works.title: Hum-ble Beginnings: Developing Touch- and Proximity-Input-Based Interfaces for Zoo-Housed Giraffes’ Audio Enrichment
works.description: Touch-based and proximity-based interfaces that let zoo giraffes play giraffe humming or white noise; over two months they used the proximity one more.
works.description_zh: 为动物园长颈鹿设计的触摸式和接近式界面，可以播放长颈鹿的哼鸣声或白噪音；两个月里它们更多使用接近式界面。
works.idea_en: Choose the input mode to fit the animal's body and behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 输入方式要贴合动物的身体和行为。
works.method: Requirements from keepers, prototyping with giraffes, then two interfaces deployed and compared.
works.method_zh: 先从饲养员处收集需求，与长颈鹿一起做原型，再部署两种界面进行比较。

paper.title: Hum-ble Beginnings: Developing Touch- and Proximity-Input-Based Interfaces for Zoo-Housed Giraffes’ Audio Enrichment

works.title: LemurLounge: Lemurs' Individual-Level, Group, and Cross-Species Use of an Interactive Audio Device in Zoos
works.description: LemurLounge is an audio device that lemurs in a mixed-species group can trigger and listen to on their own; the study follows 14 lemurs of three species.
works.description_zh: LemurLounge 是一个音频装置，混养群体中的狐猴可以自己触发并独自收听；研究追踪了三个物种的 14 只狐猴。
works.idea_en: Design group enrichment that individuals can choose to use alone.
works.idea_zh: 为群体设计丰容，同时让个体可以选择独自使用。
works.method: Enclosed listening space with sensor-triggered audio, deployed in the lemurs' habitat with individual-level logging.
works.method_zh: 带有传感触发音频的封闭收听空间，部署在狐猴栖息地中，并记录每只个体的使用情况。

paper.title: LemurLounge: Lemurs' Individual-Level, Group, and Cross-Species Use of an Interactive Audio Device in Zoos

works.title: Reshaping Human-Animal Relationships: Exploring Lemur and Human Enrichment through Smell, Sound, and Sight
works.description: A device that lets lemurs trigger smells, sounds and visuals in their enclosure, plus a matching device that shows visitors the lemurs' choices.
works.description_zh: 一个让狐猴在展区内触发气味、声音和画面的装置，以及一个向游客展示狐猴选择的配套装置。
works.idea_en: Show visitors what the animals chose, instead of letting them interact directly.
works.idea_zh: 向游客展示动物的选择，而不是让游客直接与动物互动。
works.method: 63-day lemur deployment comparing modalities, then a 20-day visitor deployment in several conditions.
works.method_zh: 对狐猴进行 63 天部署比较不同感官，再在多种条件下对游客进行 20 天部署。

paper.title: Reshaping Human-Animal Relationships: Exploring Lemur and Human Enrichment through Smell, Sound, and Sight

works.title: CreatureConnect: Exploring Shared Control of Multimodal Displays Between People and Lemurs
works.description: CreatureConnect is a distributed device through which lemurs and zoo visitors jointly control sounds, smells and visuals on both sides of the enclosure.
works.description_zh: CreatureConnect 是一个分布式装置，狐猴和动物园游客可以共同控制展区两侧的声音、气味和画面。
works.idea_en: Shared control can make zoo animals and people co-users of one system.
works.idea_zh: 共享控制可以让动物园动物和人成为同一系统的共同使用者。
works.method: Linked controls inside and outside the enclosure; 541 lemur interactions and 16,139 visitors observed over 20 days.
works.method_zh: 展区内外的控制装置相互连接；20 天内记录了 541 次狐猴交互并观察了 16139 名游客。

paper.title: CreatureConnect: Exploring Shared Control of Multimodal Displays Between People and Lemurs

works.title: Swing it On: Design of Responsive Acoustic Environments for Zoo-housed Colobus Monkeys
works.description: An interactive acoustic system that turns a colobus monkeys' swing into an interface: the higher they swing, the more soundscape layers play.
works.description_zh: 一个互动声音系统，把疣猴的秋千变成界面：荡得越高，播放的声景层次越多。
works.idea_en: Turn an object the animal already uses into the controller.
works.idea_zh: 把动物已经在用的物件变成控制器。
works.method: Motion sensing on the swing mapped to layered stream, insect and bird sounds, with an evaluation protocol at Zoo New England.
works.method_zh: 秋千上的运动感应映射到溪流、昆虫、鸟鸣等层叠声音，并在新英格兰动物园制定评估方案。

paper.title: Swing it On: Design of Responsive Acoustic Environments for Zoo-housed Colobus Monkeys

works.title: Colobus Curio Cabinet: A Modular, Mirror-Based, Co-Designed Enrichment Proposal for Colobus guereza
works.description: A wall-mounted 'curio cabinet' of modular mirror and screen inserts designed with keepers for colobus monkeys, who are drawn to reflective surfaces.
works.description_zh: 一个挂在墙上的“珍奇柜”，由模块化的镜子和屏幕组件构成，与饲养员共同为喜欢反光表面的疣猴设计。
works.idea_en: Build enrichment around what the animals already find fascinating.
works.idea_zh: 围绕动物本来就着迷的东西来设计丰容。
works.method: Modular cabinet with swappable mirror and screen modules behind natural-looking covers, co-designed with zoo staff.
works.method_zh: 模块化柜体，外罩仿自然外观，内部镜子和屏幕模块可更换，与动物园员工共同设计。

paper.title: Colobus Curio Cabinet: A Modular, Mirror-Based, Co-Designed Enrichment Proposal for Colobus guereza

works.title: Outfoxed: Design and Evaluation of a Modular Interactive Puzzle for Cognitive Enrichment of Zoo Animals
works.description: Outfoxed is a modular puzzle feeder with adjustable difficulty and multisensory feedback, deployed with an Arctic fox and piloted with coatis.
works.description_zh: Outfoxed 是一个难度可调、带多感官反馈的模块化益智喂食器，与一只北极狐一起部署，并在长鼻浣熊身上试用。
works.idea_en: Adaptive difficulty keeps a puzzle engaging without a keeper resetting it.
works.idea_zh: 自适应难度让谜题保持吸引力，而不需要饲养员反复重置。
works.method: Modular sensor-equipped puzzle levels deployed over four weeks, analysed with HCI and animal science measures.
works.method_zh: 装有传感器的模块化谜题关卡部署四周，结合人机交互和动物科学的指标进行分析。

paper.title: Outfoxed: Design and Evaluation of a Modular Interactive Puzzle for Cognitive Enrichment of Zoo Animals

works.title: BearBubbles: Interactive Olfactory Enrichment to Encourage Foraging in Zoo Animals
works.description: BearBubbles releases scented bubbles when two American black bears approach, giving them control over olfactory enrichment and encouraging foraging.
works.description_zh: BearBubbles 在两只美洲黑熊靠近时释放带气味的泡泡，让它们掌控嗅觉丰容，并鼓励觅食行为。
works.idea_en: Smell is a rich enrichment channel that the animal can switch on.
works.idea_zh: 气味是一种丰富的丰容通道，而且可以由动物自己开启。
works.method: Proximity-activated scented bubble machine deployed for three weeks at Zoo New England.
works.method_zh: 由接近触发的气味泡泡机，在新英格兰动物园部署三周。

paper.title: BearBubbles: Interactive Olfactory Enrichment to Encourage Foraging in Zoo Animals

works.title: Exploring the Cockatoo's Engagement with Audiovisual Stimuli: An Inclusive Avian-IoT Interaction Design
works.description: A low-effort avian IoT system that lets a captive salmon-crested cockatoo engage voluntarily with audio and visual stimuli, monitored remotely.
works.description_zh: 一个低干预的鸟类物联网系统，让一只圈养的鲑冠凤头鹦鹉自愿接触声音和图像刺激，并可远程监测。
works.idea_en: Enrichment can be voluntary, remote and light-touch.
works.idea_zh: 丰容可以是自愿的、远程的、轻干预的。
works.method: Mobile app, central server and in-enclosure devices delivering multimodal stimuli and logging engagement.
works.method_zh: 手机应用、中央服务器和笼舍内设备提供多模态刺激并记录参与情况。

paper.title: Exploring the Cockatoo's Engagement with Audiovisual Stimuli: An Inclusive Avian-IoT Interaction Design

works.title: Use of a Tablet-Based Communication Board and Subsequent Choice and Behavioral Correspondences in a Goffin's Cockatoo (Cacatua goffiana)
works.description: A Goffin's cockatoo learned to use a commercial tablet communication board to request foods, activities and interactions, and her requests were checked for consistency.
works.description_zh: 一只戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉学会使用市售平板沟通板来请求食物、活动和互动，研究者检验了她的请求是否前后一致。
works.idea_en: Augmentative communication devices made for people can give a bird a voice.
works.idea_zh: 为人设计的辅助沟通设备也可以让鸟拥有“声音”。
works.method: Associative training on an Android picture board; responses verified with follow-up questions and body language.
works.method_zh: 在安卓图片板上进行联想训练，并通过追问和肢体语言验证她的回答。

paper.title: Use of a Tablet-Based Communication Board and Subsequent Choice and Behavioral Correspondences in a Goffin's Cockatoo (Cacatua goffiana)

works.title: Ellie Talks About the Weather: Toward Evaluating the Expressive and Enrichment Potential of a Tablet-Based Speech Board in a Single Goffin’s Cockatoo
works.description: Seven months of a single cockatoo's use of a tablet speech board, with a framework for evaluating its expressive potential and enrichment value.
works.description_zh: 记录一只凤头鹦鹉七个月使用平板语音板的情况，并提出评估其表达潜力和丰容价值的框架。
works.idea_en: Evaluate an animal's AAC use both as communication and as enrichment.
works.idea_zh: 评估动物使用辅助沟通设备时，既要看作沟通，也要看作丰容。
works.method: 129 sessions over 190 days coded with a new schema for expressive and enrichment measures.
works.method_zh: 用新的编码方案对 190 天内的 129 次使用进行编码，衡量表达和丰容两方面。

paper.title: Ellie Talks About the Weather: Toward Evaluating the Expressive and Enrichment Potential of a Tablet-Based Speech Board in a Single Goffin’s Cockatoo

works.title: Towards Interface Design for Parrot-Human Communication: Investigating Parrot Selections of Speech Board Representations
works.description: A four-year study of a Goffin's cockatoo using three successive speech board interfaces, examining how interface design affects her selections.
works.description_zh: 一项为期四年的研究：一只戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉先后使用三种语音板界面，考察界面设计如何影响她的选择。
works.idea_en: Interface design variables that matter for humans also shape what a parrot says.
works.idea_zh: 对人重要的界面设计变量，同样会影响鹦鹉“说”什么。
works.method: Longitudinal in-the-wild analysis of selections across button size, layout and representation type.
works.method_zh: 在真实生活环境中长期分析按钮大小、布局和表征方式不同时的选择。

paper.title: Towards Interface Design for Parrot-Human Communication: Investigating Parrot Selections of Speech Board Representations

works.title: TamagoPhone: A Framework for Augmenting Artificial Incubators to Enable Vocal Interaction Between Bird Parents and Eggs
works.description: TamagoPhone proposes adding two-way audio streaming to artificial incubators so that bird parents and embryos can hear each other before hatching.
works.description_zh: TamagoPhone 提议为人工孵化器加入双向音频流，让鸟类亲鸟和蛋中的胚胎在孵化前就能听到彼此。
works.idea_en: Incubators save eggs but cut a conversation; technology can reconnect it.
works.idea_zh: 孵化器保住了蛋，却切断了一场对话；技术可以把它重新接上。
works.method: Research design for low-latency audio links between a nest and an incubator, based on a review of prenatal vocal learning in birds.
works.method_zh: 基于对鸟类胚胎期声音学习的文献综述，设计巢与孵化器之间的低延迟音频连接方案。

paper.title: TamagoPhone: A Framework for Augmenting Artificial Incubators to Enable Vocal Interaction Between Bird Parents and Eggs

works.title: Listening with the Fishes: Aquatic Audio Interfaces to Experience Acoustic Underwater Worlds
works.description: A pilot aquarium installation that lets visitors hear the underwater soundscape and fish sounds, as a first step toward acoustic enrichment for fish.
works.description_zh: 一个水族馆试点装置，让游客听到水下声景和鱼的声音，作为为鱼提供声音丰容的第一步。
works.idea_en: Make people hear the noise they add to an animal's world.
works.idea_zh: 让人听见自己给动物世界增加的噪音。
works.method: Hydrophone-based audio interface in a public aquarium, part of a proposed three-stage system.
works.method_zh: 在公共水族馆中使用基于水听器的音频界面，是拟议三阶段系统的一部分。

paper.title: Listening with the Fishes: Aquatic Audio Interfaces to Experience Acoustic Underwater Worlds

works.title: The Animal Whisperer Project
works.description: Apps that use multimodal generative AI to read the body language of animals such as cows, horses and dogs from a phone camera and advise people how to behave.
works.description_zh: 一组应用，用多模态生成式人工智能通过手机摄像头读取牛、马、狗等动物的肢体语言，并建议人该如何应对。
works.idea_en: A phone that reads an animal's signals can prevent conflicts on a walk.
works.idea_zh: 一部能读懂动物信号的手机，可以在散步时避免冲突。
works.method: GPT-4-based prompts with species-specific knowledge applied to images of animals in context.
works.method_zh: 基于 GPT-4 的提示词结合特定物种知识，分析处于情境中的动物图像。

paper.title: The Animal Whisperer Project

works.title: Rosetta Bone - Bridging the Language Gap Between Dogs and Humans with a QR Code-Enabled Communication System
works.description: Rosetta Bone is a QR-code tag on a dog's collar that tells a new caretaker the commands and language the dog already knows.
works.description_zh: Rosetta Bone 是狗项圈上的二维码标签，告诉新的照顾者这只狗已经熟悉的指令和语言。
works.idea_en: Translate for the human, not for the dog.
works.idea_zh: 要翻译的是人，而不是狗。
works.method: Collar QR tag linked to a web app that plays the owner's recorded cues in the dog's familiar language.
works.method_zh: 项圈二维码链接到网页应用，用狗熟悉的语言播放主人录好的指令。

paper.title: Rosetta Bone - Bridging the Language Gap Between Dogs and Humans with a QR Code-Enabled Communication System

works.title: Playful rocksalt system: animal-computer interaction design in wild environments
works.description: Playful Rocksalt lets people in a city interact in real time with wild deer in a forest, which visit a salt lick fitted with sensors and a camera.
works.description_zh: Playful Rocksalt 让城市里的人与森林中的野鹿实时互动：野鹿会来到装有传感器和摄像头的盐块旁。
works.idea_en: A salt lick can be an interface between city dwellers and wild animals.
works.idea_zh: 一块舔盐可以成为城市居民与野生动物之间的界面。
works.method: Rock salt fitted with sensors streams deer visits to a handheld device for remote users.
works.method_zh: 装有传感器的盐块把鹿来访的情况实时传到远程用户的手持设备上。

paper.title: Playful rocksalt system: animal-computer interaction design in wild environments

works.title: Animal-to-Animal Data Sharing Mechanism for Wildlife Monitoring in Fukushima Exclusion Zone
works.description: Sensor collars on wild animals in the Fukushima exclusion zone exchange data when animals meet, so that the animals themselves carry monitoring data out of an area without infrastructure.
works.description_zh: 福岛禁区内野生动物佩戴的传感项圈在动物相遇时互相交换数据，由动物自己把监测数据带出没有基础设施的区域。
works.idea_en: Let animals be the network where there are no roads, power or signal.
works.idea_zh: 在没有道路、电力和信号的地方，让动物本身成为网络。
works.method: Wildlife-borne sensor nodes that wake to communicate only when several animals are together, to save battery.
works.method_zh: 由野生动物携带的传感节点，只在多只动物聚集时唤醒通信，以节省电量。

paper.title: Animal-to-Animal Data Sharing Mechanism for Wildlife Monitoring in Fukushima Exclusion Zone

works.title: Utilizing the Cyberforest live sound system with social media to remotely conduct woodland bird censuses in Central Japan
works.description: Cyberforest streams live sound from remote Japanese forests on the internet, and volunteers listening together on social media carried out bird censuses.
works.description_zh: Cyberforest 在互联网上实时播放日本偏远森林的声音，志愿者在社交媒体上一起收听，完成鸟类普查。
works.idea_en: Live sound plus social media can turn remote listeners into a census team.
works.idea_zh: 实时声音加上社交媒体，可以把远方的听众变成一支普查队。
works.method: Unmanned microphones streaming 8 hours a day for over five years; censuses run with participants listening simultaneously online.
works.method_zh: 无人值守的麦克风每天直播 8 小时，持续五年以上；参与者同时在线收听进行普查。

paper.title: Utilizing the Cyberforest live sound system with social media to remotely conduct woodland bird censuses in Central Japan

works.title: Designing for wearability in animal biotelemetry
works.description: A preliminary study of a cat wearing off-the-shelf biotelemetry devices, leading to a wearer-centred framework for designing animal trackers.
works.description_zh: 一项初步研究：观察一只猫佩戴市售生物遥测设备的情况，由此提出以佩戴者为中心的动物追踪器设计框架。
works.idea_en: The animal that carries a tracker is its user; design for its comfort.
works.idea_zh: 佩戴追踪器的动物就是它的用户；要为它的舒适而设计。
works.method: Video observation of the cat's reactions to device presence, analysed for signs of discomfort.
works.method_zh: 录像观察猫对设备的反应，分析其不适迹象。

paper.title: Designing for wearability in animal biotelemetry

works.title: Towards Harmonious Coexistence: A Bioacoustic-Driven Animal-Computer Interaction System for Preventing Ship Collisions with North Atlantic Right Whales
works.description: A system that recognises North Atlantic right whale calls with a neural network and alerts nearby ships to avoid collisions.
works.description_zh: 一套系统：用神经网络识别北大西洋露脊鲸的叫声，并提醒附近船只避免相撞。
works.idea_en: Let the whale's voice change the ship's course.
works.idea_zh: 让鲸的声音改变船的航向。
works.method: Spectrograms of whale vocalisations classified by a CNN; detections feed a ship-facing warning interface.
works.method_zh: 把鲸叫声转为声谱图并用卷积神经网络分类，检测结果传入面向船只的警告界面。

paper.title: Towards Harmonious Coexistence: A Bioacoustic-Driven Animal-Computer Interaction System for Preventing Ship Collisions with North Atlantic Right Whales

works.title: Advancing Cattle Health Monitoring through ACI-Driven Wearable Sensor Technology: A Case Study of Leg-Worn System Development
works.description: The design of a leg-worn health sensor for dairy cattle, developed with ACI principles and with the needs of cows and farmers in mind.
works.description_zh: 一款奶牛腿部佩戴的健康传感器的设计过程，依据动物-计算机交互原则，同时考虑奶牛和农民的需要。
works.idea_en: Livestock wearables should be designed for the cow's comfort and the farm's routines.
works.idea_zh: 家畜可穿戴设备要为奶牛的舒适和农场的日常流程而设计。
works.method: Iterative leg-band design, field observation on a farm, and sensor data for disease detection.
works.method_zh: 迭代设计腿环，在农场实地观察，并用传感数据检测疾病。

paper.title: Advancing Cattle Health Monitoring through ACI-Driven Wearable Sensor Technology: A Case Study of Leg-Worn System Development

works.title: Ewe’ve Got Nerve: Electronic Headwear System for Sheep Group Behavior Dynamics
works.description: Electronic headwear for sheep that records microclimate, head and eye movement and bleating to study how individuals shape flock behaviour.
works.description_zh: 一种羊用电子头饰，记录微气候、头部和眼部运动以及叫声，用来研究个体如何影响羊群行为。
works.idea_en: Understand the flock by listening to each sheep.
works.idea_zh: 通过聆听每一只羊来理解整个羊群。
works.method: Head-mounted sensor package with environmental, inertial and audio sensing, prototyped for field use.
works.method_zh: 头戴式传感模块集成环境、惯性和声音传感，为野外使用制作原型。

paper.title: Ewe’ve Got Nerve: Electronic Headwear System for Sheep Group Behavior Dynamics

works.title: Confronting People's Fears about Bats: Combining Multi-modal and Environmentally Sensed Data to Promote Curiosity and Discovery
works.description: PlayBat is a public display that combines a tangible interface, a quiz-like story and live bat-call data from sensors in a London park.
works.description_zh: PlayBat 是一个公共展示装置，结合可触摸界面、问答式故事和伦敦公园中传感器实时采集的蝙蝠叫声数据。
works.idea_en: Real-time data from a feared animal can turn fear into curiosity.
works.idea_zh: 来自令人害怕的动物的实时数据，可以把恐惧变成好奇。
works.method: Multimodal physical display fed by IoT bat detectors, evaluated with members of the public.
works.method_zh: 由物联网蝙蝠探测器供数的多模态实体展示装置，与公众一起评估。

paper.title: Confronting People's Fears about Bats: Combining Multi-modal and Environmentally Sensed Data to Promote Curiosity and Discovery

works.title: Smart Habitat: A Wildlife Rehabilitation System
works.description: A sensor-equipped habitat for rehabilitating orphaned Virginia opossum joeys that lets volunteers monitor them with less human contact.
works.description_zh: 一个装有传感器的栖息箱，用于救助孤儿弗吉尼亚负鼠幼崽，让志愿者减少与它们的接触也能照看。
works.idea_en: Wild animals in care need monitoring that keeps humans at a distance.
works.idea_zh: 受救助的野生动物需要让人保持距离的监测方式。
works.method: Microcontroller, environmental sensors and an Android app, designed from interviews and six months of observation.
works.method_zh: 微控制器、环境传感器和安卓应用，基于访谈和六个月的观察设计。

paper.title: Smart Habitat: A Wildlife Rehabilitation System

works.title: Designing Urban Noticing Probes for Community Animals and Cohabitation in Türkiye
works.description: Design probes based on the 'arts of noticing' that help residents in Türkiye notice community street animals and rethink cohabitation.
works.description_zh: 基于“注意的艺术”设计的探针，帮助土耳其居民注意社区里的街头动物，重新思考共同生活。
works.idea_en: Probes can decentre the human by directing attention to animals in the street.
works.idea_zh: 探针可以把注意力引向街头的动物，从而把人从中心移开。
works.method: Probe kits deployed with residents and analysed through noticing theory.
works.method_zh: 向居民发放探针套件，并用“注意”理论分析结果。

paper.title: Designing Urban Noticing Probes for Community Animals and Cohabitation in Türkiye

works.title: Pig Chase (Playing with Pigs)
works.description: Pig Chase is a game in which pigs in a farm pen and a person on an iPad play together: the pigs follow a ball of light on a large touch display with their snouts.
works.description_zh: Pig Chase 是一款游戏：猪圈里的猪和拿着 iPad 的人一起玩，猪用鼻子在大型触摸屏上追逐一个光球。
works.idea_en: Play can make farm animals visible as individuals with minds, and give them something to do.
works.idea_zh: 玩耍能让人把农场动物看作有心智的个体，也给它们找点事做。
works.method: A touch-sensitive wall display in the pen is linked over the internet to a tablet game for a human player.
works.method_zh: 猪圈里的触敏墙面显示屏通过互联网连接到人类玩家手中的平板游戏。

works.title: Apps for Apes
works.description: Apps for Apes gives iPads to zoos so that orangutans can use drawing, music and video apps as enrichment, with keepers holding the tablet.
works.description_zh: Apps for Apes 向动物园捐赠 iPad，让红毛猩猩在饲养员手持平板的情况下使用绘画、音乐和视频应用作为丰容。
works.idea_en: Off-the-shelf tablets can become enrichment, and a public story about ape minds.
works.idea_zh: 现成的平板电脑可以成为丰容工具，也能向公众讲述猿类心智的故事。
works.method: Donated iPads with human-facing apps, used through the mesh during keeper-led sessions.
works.method_zh: 捐赠的 iPad 装有面向人的应用，在饲养员主导的时段隔着网笼使用。

works.title: CleverPet Hub
works.description: CleverPet Hub is a home game console for dogs: three touch pads light up and the dog earns food by pressing them in the right patterns, with games getting harder over time.
works.description_zh: CleverPet Hub 是一台家用狗游戏机：三个触摸垫会亮起，狗按正确顺序按下就能得到食物，游戏难度会逐步提高。
works.idea_en: A lab learning task, packaged as a home product, can keep a dog busy while people are out.
works.idea_zh: 把实验室里的学习任务包装成家用产品，就能在人不在家时让狗有事可做。
works.method: Light-up touch pads, a food dispenser and adaptive software that runs operant learning games, controlled by an app.
works.method_zh: 发光触摸垫、食物投放器和运行操作性学习游戏的自适应软件，通过应用控制。

works.title: Games for Cats (Friskies)
works.description: Friskies' Games for Cats are tablet apps in which cats chase fish, lasers and bugs on screen with their paws.
works.description_zh: Friskies 的 Games for Cats 是一组平板应用，猫可以用爪子追逐屏幕上的鱼、激光点和虫子。
works.idea_en: A mass-market app made screens something cats could play with.
works.idea_zh: 一款大众应用让屏幕成了猫可以玩的东西。
works.method: Touchscreen games with high-contrast moving targets and simple touch detection sized for paws.
works.method_zh: 高对比度移动目标的触屏游戏，触碰检测按爪子大小设计。

works.title: Halter virtual fencing collars
works.description: Halter's solar-powered GPS collars keep cattle inside virtual fences and move them between paddocks, using sound and vibration cues instead of wire.
works.description_zh: Halter 的太阳能 GPS 项圈用声音和振动提示代替铁丝网，把牛群留在虚拟围栏内，并引导它们转场。
works.idea_en: When cows learn to follow cues from a collar, the fence becomes software.
works.idea_zh: 当牛学会听从项圈的提示，围栏就变成了软件。
works.method: GPS and sensor collars trained with audio and vibration cues, managed through a farmer's app; low electric pulses as a last resort.
works.method_zh: GPS 与传感器项圈通过声音和振动提示训练牛，农民通过应用管理；轻微电脉冲作为最后手段。

works.title: Lely Astronaut milking robot
works.description: The Lely Astronaut is a milking robot that cows visit on their own schedule; the robot identifies each cow, cleans and attaches cups, and records her data.
works.description_zh: Lely Astronaut 是一台挤奶机器人，奶牛按自己的时间前来；机器人识别每头牛，清洁并套上奶杯，同时记录它的数据。
works.idea_en: Voluntary milking lets the animal start the interaction with the machine.
works.idea_zh: 自愿挤奶让动物成为与机器互动的发起者。
works.method: Robot arm with laser teat detection, collar-based cow identification and feed incentives in the milking box.
works.method_zh: 机械臂配合激光乳头定位、基于项圈的奶牛识别，以及挤奶间里的饲料激励。

works.title: Beewise BeeHome
works.description: BeeHome is a solar-powered container of beehives in which cameras and a robotic arm inspect frames and treat colonies, with beekeepers working remotely.
works.description_zh: BeeHome 是一个太阳能供电的蜂箱集装箱，摄像头和机械臂在其中检查巢框、处理蜂群，养蜂人则远程操作。
works.idea_en: Robotic care can watch a colony continuously, but it also changes the beekeeper's relationship to bees.
works.idea_zh: 机器人照料可以持续看护蜂群，也改变了养蜂人与蜜蜂的关系。
works.method: Computer vision on frame images, a gantry robot arm and climate control inside a multi-hive unit.
works.method_zh: 对巢框图像做计算机视觉分析，多蜂箱单元内配有龙门式机械臂和温湿度控制。

works.title: AudioMoth
works.description: AudioMoth is a small, low-cost, open-source acoustic logger that researchers and volunteers leave in the field to record bats, birds, insects and whole soundscapes.
works.description_zh: AudioMoth 是一款小巧、低成本的开源声学记录器，研究者和志愿者把它放在野外，记录蝙蝠、鸟类、昆虫乃至整片声景。
works.idea_en: Cheap open hardware lets many more people listen to wildlife.
works.idea_zh: 便宜的开源硬件让更多人能够聆听野生动物。
works.method: Programmable microcontroller board with a MEMS microphone recording audible and ultrasonic sound to a memory card, with on-board detection options.
works.method_zh: 可编程微控制器电路板配 MEMS 麦克风，把可听声和超声波录到存储卡，并可进行板载检测。

paper.title: AudioMoth: Evaluation of a smart open acoustic device for monitoring biodiversity and the environment

works.title: Whale Safe
works.description: Whale Safe combines an acoustic buoy that detects whale calls, whale-presence models and sightings to warn ships in the Santa Barbara Channel and grade how well they slow down.
works.description_zh: Whale Safe 结合可探测鲸叫声的声学浮标、鲸出没模型和目击记录，向圣塔芭芭拉海峡的船只发出警告，并为它们的减速表现打分。
works.idea_en: Make whales present in shipping decisions with live data and public report cards.
works.idea_zh: 用实时数据和公开的成绩单，让鲸出现在航运决策中。
works.method: Near-real-time AI detection of whale calls on a buoy, blended with ocean models and sightings, plus AIS ship-speed tracking.
works.method_zh: 浮标上的人工智能近实时识别鲸叫声，与海洋模型和目击数据融合，并通过 AIS 追踪船速。

works.title: ICARUS and Movebank: an Internet of Animals
works.description: ICARUS and Movebank track small animals such as birds and bats worldwide with tiny tags read from space, and share the movement data openly as an 'Internet of Animals'.
works.description_zh: ICARUS 和 Movebank 用可从太空读取的微型标签追踪全球的鸟类、蝙蝠等小型动物，并以“动物互联网”的方式公开共享运动数据。
works.idea_en: Animals carrying sensors become a planetary sensing network.
works.idea_zh: 携带传感器的动物组成了一张覆盖地球的感知网络。
works.method: Solar tags with GPS and accelerometers uploaded to a receiver on the International Space Station (from 2018) and later satellites; data archived in Movebank.
works.method_zh: 带 GPS 和加速度计的太阳能标签把数据上传到国际空间站上的接收器（2018 年起），后改用卫星；数据存档于 Movebank。

paper.title: Going wild: what a global small-animal tracking system could do for experimental biologists

works.title: Crittercam
works.description: Crittercam is a camera and data logger attached to wild animals, from sharks and seals to penguins, that records video and environmental data from the animal's own position.
works.description_zh: Crittercam 是一种装在野生动物身上的摄像与数据记录装置，从鲨鱼、海豹到企鹅，从动物自己的位置记录视频和环境数据。
works.idea_en: Put the camera on the animal and you see its world, not ours.
works.idea_zh: 把摄像头装在动物身上，看到的就是它的世界，而不是我们的。
works.method: Waterproof video and sensor package with suction, harness or fin attachment and timed release for recovery.
works.method_zh: 防水的视频与传感器模块，用吸盘、背带或鳍夹固定，并定时脱落以便回收。

paper.title: An Advanced Solid-state Animal-Borne Video and Environmental Data-Logging Device (“Crittercam”) for Marine Research

works.title: RoboFish
works.description: RoboFish is a robotic guppy moved by a magnet under the tank that live guppies accept as a group member, especially when it has realistic eyes and moves naturally.
works.description_zh: RoboFish 是一条由鱼缸下方磁铁驱动的机器孔雀鱼；当它有逼真的眼睛、动作自然时，活体孔雀鱼会把它当作同伴。
works.idea_en: A robot can join an animal group as a participant, and in doing so test how the group decides.
works.idea_zh: 机器人可以作为参与者加入动物群体，并借此检验群体如何作决定。
works.method: Replica fish on a magnetic base driven by a wheeled robot below the tank, with closed-loop video tracking of live fish.
works.method_zh: 带磁性底座的仿真鱼由鱼缸下方的轮式机器人驱动，配合对活鱼的闭环视频追踪。

paper.title: RoboFish: increased acceptance of interactive robotic fish with realistic eyes and natural motion patterns by live Trinidadian guppies

works.title: RoboBee: a dancing honeybee robot
works.description: RoboBee is a robotic honeybee that performs the waggle dance inside a hive; live bees follow its dance and some fly to the location it signals.
works.description_zh: RoboBee 是一只在蜂巢内跳“摇摆舞”的机器蜜蜂；活蜂会跟随它的舞蹈，其中一些会飞向它所指示的位置。
works.idea_en: To speak with bees, a robot has to dance in their language.
works.idea_zh: 要与蜜蜂对话，机器人必须用它们的语言跳舞。
works.method: A bee replica on a robotic arm reproduces waggle-dance movement and vibration in an observation hive, with tracking of recruited foragers.
works.method_zh: 机械臂上的仿真蜜蜂在观察蜂箱中重现摇摆舞的动作和振动，并追踪被招募的采集蜂。

paper.title: Dancing Honey bee Robot Elicits Dance-Following and Recruits Foragers

works.title: No More Woof
works.description: No More Woof is a crowdfunded EEG headset for dogs that claimed to translate a dog's brain activity into short spoken phrases such as 'I'm hungry'.
works.description_zh: No More Woof 是一款众筹的狗用脑电头戴设备，宣称能把狗的脑活动翻译成“我饿了”之类的简短人话。
works.idea_en: The wish to hear pets speak is strong enough to fund devices science cannot yet back.
works.idea_zh: 想听宠物说话的愿望如此强烈，足以为科学尚不能支持的设备众筹资金。
works.method: EEG sensors, a microcomputer and a loudspeaker mapping rough brain-state patterns to prerecorded phrases.
works.method_zh: 脑电传感器、微型计算机和扬声器，把粗略的脑状态模式映射到预录的短语上。

works.title: Project Pigeon
works.description: During World War II, Project Pigeon trained pigeons to peck at a target image on a screen in a missile's nose cone so that their pecks would steer it.
works.description_zh: 二战期间，“鸽子计划”训练鸽子啄击导弹鼻锥内屏幕上的目标图像，用啄击来操纵导弹方向。
works.idea_en: An early animal-operated interface shows how quickly animal labour can be put to human, and violent, uses.
works.idea_zh: 这个早期由动物操作的界面表明，动物的劳动可以多么迅速地被用于人类的、甚至暴力的目的。
works.method: Operant conditioning of pigeons to peck a projected target; peck position on the screen was translated into steering signals.
works.method_zh: 用操作性条件反射训练鸽子啄击投射的目标，屏幕上的啄击位置被转换为转向信号。

paper.title: Pigeons in a pelican.

works.title: DeepSqueak
works.description: DeepSqueak is open software that uses deep learning to find and classify the ultrasonic calls of rats and mice in recordings.
works.description_zh: DeepSqueak 是一款开源软件，用深度学习在录音中找到并分类大鼠和小鼠的超声波叫声。
works.idea_en: Make inaudible animal voices searchable and they become data about welfare and emotion.
works.idea_zh: 让人听不到的动物声音变得可检索，它们就成了关于福利和情绪的数据。
works.method: Faster R-CNN object detection on spectrograms, with clustering of call types, in a MATLAB interface.
works.method_zh: 在声谱图上使用 Faster R-CNN 目标检测，并对叫声类型聚类，提供 MATLAB 界面。

paper.title: DeepSqueak: a deep learning-based system for detection and analysis of ultrasonic vocalizations

works.title: Soundboard-trained dogs (FluentPet buttons)
works.description: A study of soundboard-trained dogs, which press recordable buttons such as FluentPet's, finding that their two-button combinations are not accidental, random or copies of their owners.
works.description_zh: 一项研究：对象是经过按钮板训练的狗（使用 FluentPet 等可录音按钮），发现它们按出的双按钮组合既非偶然、非随机，也不是在模仿主人。
works.idea_en: A consumer device can become a large-scale research instrument when owners share data.
works.idea_zh: 当主人愿意共享数据时，一款消费产品就能变成大规模研究工具。
works.method: Button-press logs from many households' FluentPet boards analysed statistically for combination patterns.
works.method_zh: 对大量家庭 FluentPet 按钮板的按压记录进行统计分析，寻找组合模式。

paper.title: Soundboard-trained dogs produce non-accidental, non-random and non-imitative two-button combinations

works.title: DOGTV
works.description: DOGTV is a television channel for dogs left at home alone, with footage and sound edited for dogs' colour vision and hearing.
works.description_zh: DOGTV 是为独自在家的狗开设的电视频道，画面和声音依据狗的色觉与听觉进行剪辑。
works.idea_en: Media can be designed for a non-human audience's senses.
works.idea_zh: 媒体可以依据非人类观众的感官来设计。
works.method: Programming grouped into relaxation, stimulation and exposure segments, with colour and frequency choices based on canine perception.
works.method_zh: 节目分为放松、刺激和脱敏三类，色彩与声音频率的选择依据狗的感知。

works.title: LANA project and the Yerkish lexigram keyboard
works.description: In the LANA project, a chimpanzee named Lana used a computer keyboard of abstract symbols, lexigrams, to request food and activities and to complete sentences; the lexigram keyboard later let the bonobo Kanzi communicate with people.
works.description_zh: 在 LANA 项目中，一只名叫 Lana 的黑猩猩使用由抽象符号（词符）组成的计算机键盘来请求食物和活动、补全句子；后来这套词符键盘也让倭黑猩猩 Kanzi 能与人交流。
works.idea_en: One of the first computer interfaces built for another species treated an ape as a user.
works.idea_zh: 最早为其他物种打造的计算机界面之一，把猿当作用户来对待。
works.method: A computer-controlled keyboard of lighted lexigram keys following Yerkish grammar, logging every key press.
works.method_zh: 由计算机控制的键盘，按键为可发光的词符，遵循 Yerkish 语法，并记录每一次按键。

paper.title: Reading and Sentence Completion by a Chimpanzee (Pan)

works.title: Underwater keyboard for dolphins
works.description: An underwater keyboard let bottlenose dolphins press symbols to get balls, rings or rubs; each key also played a computer-generated whistle, which the dolphins began to imitate.
works.description_zh: 一块水下键盘让宽吻海豚按下符号来获得球、圈或抚摸；每个键还会播放计算机生成的哨声，海豚后来开始模仿这些声音。
works.idea_en: Give animals a choice interface with sounds attached and they may adopt the sounds.
works.idea_zh: 给动物一个附带声音的选择界面，它们可能会把这些声音学为己用。
works.method: Underwater keys with visual symbols, each paired with a synthetic whistle and a reward, at Marine World Africa USA.
works.method_zh: 带视觉符号的水下按键，每个键配一种合成哨声和一种奖励，设于美国 Marine World Africa USA。

paper.title: Spontaneous vocal mimicry and production by bottlenose dolphins (Tursiops truncatus): Evidence for vocal learning.

works.title: CyberTracker
works.description: CyberTracker is a handheld field computer with an icon-based interface that lets expert trackers who cannot read or write record animal tracks and sightings with GPS.
works.description_zh: CyberTracker 是一种手持野外计算机，采用图标界面，让不识字的追踪专家也能用 GPS 记录动物足迹和目击情况。
works.idea_en: Design the interface around the expert's knowledge, not their literacy.
works.idea_zh: 围绕专家的知识而不是其读写能力来设计界面。
works.method: Icon-driven data capture sequences on rugged handhelds with GPS, later a free app used by conservation projects worldwide.
works.method_zh: 在坚固的 GPS 手持设备上以图标驱动的数据采集流程，后来成为全球保护项目使用的免费应用。

paper.title: Extended abstract a field computer for animal trackers
